18.29.379.m: for they thought [they were] possessing Indra, as it were.

18.29.379.s: tasmāt tīvrasome sarva eva camasādhvaryava ānandino 'cchāvākasya śastraṃ pratyāgṛṇanti
18.29.379.d: तस्मात् तीव्रसोमे सर्व एव चमसाध्वर्यव आनन्दिनो ऽच्छावाकस्य शस्त्रं प्रत्यागृणन्ति
18.29.379.m: Therefore, in the Tīvrasoma rite, all the cup-adhvaryus, rejoicing, utter the response to the recitation of the acchāvāka priest,

18.29.379.s: sendrā iva hi manyante tarhi vāva tadāsīt
18.29.379.d: सेन्द्रा इव हि मन्यन्ते तर्हि वाव तदासीत्
18.29.379.m: for they think [they are] possessing Indra, as it were. That was indeed at that time.

18.29.379.s: tad u vā āhuḥ sarva evaitarhi yajñaḥ sendras | iti tam̐ hābhiṣuṣuvuḥ ||
18.29.379.d: तद् उ वा आहुः सर्व एवैतर्हि यज्ञः सेन्द्रस् । इति तँ हाभिषुषुवुः ॥
18.29.379.m: Moreover they say: “The entire sacrifice now possesses Indra.” They pressed [soma] for him.

18.30.379.s: ihā ihā ihā | iti | ihehīhehīhehi | iti ha vā enaṃ tad ūcus | bṛhad bṛhad bṛhat | iti |
18.30.379.d: इहा इहा इहा । इति । इहेहीहेहीहेहि । इति ह वा एनं तद् ऊचुस् । बृहद् बृहद् बृहत् । इति ।
18.30.379.m: “Here, here, here!” “Come here, come here, come here!” thus indeed they spoke to him then. “Great, great, great!”

18.30.379.s: idaṃ te bṛhad annādyaṃ tad abhyupāvartasva | iti ha vā enaṃ tad ūcus
18.30.379.d: इदं ते बृहद् अन्नाद्यं तद् अभ्युपावर्तस्व । इति ह वा एनं तद् ऊचुस्
18.30.379.m: “This is your great food; turn back to it!” thus indeed they spoke to him then.

18.30.379.s: tad etan mādhyaṃdinasya savanasyānyatrāpi nidānam | sa śṛtakalaśam ekadhanānāṃ prātaḥsavane 'vanayet |
18.30.379.d: तद् एतन् माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्यान्यत्रापि निदानम् । स शृतकलशम् एकधनानां प्रातःसवने ऽवनयेत् ।
18.30.379.m: This is also the underlying reason for the midday extraction in other contexts. He should pour into the heated vessel [water] from the ekadhana jars at the morning extraction;

18.30.379.s: vimathitaṃ tṛtīyasavane sāsya tīvratā saptadaśa stomo bhavati
18.30.379.d: विमथितं तृतीयसवने सास्य तीव्रता सप्तदश स्तोमो भवति
18.30.379.m: churned curd at the third extraction. That is its pungency. The stoma is seventeenfold.

18.30.379.s: saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai garbhiṇī vaḍabā lalāmī dakṣiṇā |
18.30.379.d: सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः प्रजापतेर् आप्त्यै गर्भिणी वडबा ललामी दक्षिणा ।
18.30.379.m: Prajāpati is seventeenfold, for obtaining Prajāpati. A pregnant mare with a blaze on the forehead is the sacrificial fee.

18.30.379.s: indriyaṃ vai garbhas | indriyaṃ lalāmaḥ sendriyatvāya
18.30.379.d: इन्द्रियं वै गर्भस् । इन्द्रियं ललामः सेन्द्रियत्वाय
18.30.379.m: The embryo is virile power; the blaze is virile power; [it is] for possessing virile power.

18.30.379.s: yo jyānyā vopatapatā vāṇimānaṃ nītaḥ syāt sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.30.379.d: यो ज्यान्या वोपतपता वाणिमानं नीतः स्यात् स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.30.379.m: He who has been brought to thinness by loss or by distress should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.

18.30.379.s: aśnute haiva tīvratām indro 'kāmayata vi pāpmānam̐ hanīya śraiṣṭhyaṃ devānāṃ gaccheyam iti
18.30.379.d: अश्नुते हैव तीव्रताम् इन्द्रो ऽकामयत वि पाप्मानँ हनीय श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानां गच्छेयम् इति
18.30.379.m: He attains pungency. Indra desired: “May I destroy evil, may I attain preeminence among the gods.”

18.30.380.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata
18.30.380.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत
18.30.380.m: He saw this sacrificial rite. He took it; he sacrificed with it.

18.30.380.s: tato vai sa vi pāpmānam ahata śraiṣṭhyaṃ devānām agacchat | yaḥ kāmayeta vi pāpmānam̐ hanīya śraiṣṭhyam̐ samānānāṃ gaccheyam iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.30.380.d: ततो वै स वि पाप्मानम् अहत श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानाम् अगच्छत् । यः कामयेत वि पाप्मानँ हनीय श्रैष्ठ्यँ समानानां गच्छेयम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.30.380.m: Thereupon he destroyed evil and attained preeminence among the gods. He who desires: “May I destroy evil, may I attain preeminence among my equals,” should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.

18.30.380.s: vy eva pāpmānam̐ hate śraiṣṭhyam̐ samānānāṃ gacchati
18.30.380.d: व्य् एव पाप्मानँ हते श्रैष्ठ्यँ समानानां गच्छति
18.30.380.m: He destroys evil and attains preeminence among his equals.

18.30.380.s: tasyātigrāhyas | vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | adhaspadaṃ tam īṃ kṛdhi yo asmām̐ abhidāsati | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā vaimṛdhāya juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
18.30.380.d: तस्यातिग्राह्यस् । वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः । अधस्पदं तम् ईं कृधि यो अस्माँ अभिदासति । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा वैमृधाय जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
18.30.380.m: His additional cup [verse is]: “Slay our enemies, Indra, / cast down those who wage war against us; / tread him beneath your feet / who works malice against us.” “You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Indra the Dispeller of Foes.”

18.30.380.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā vaimṛdhāya | iti tasya trivṛt pañcadaśau viparyāsam̐ stomau bhavatas
18.30.380.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा वैमृधाय । इति तस्य त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशौ विपर्यासँ स्तोमौ भवतस्
18.30.380.m: Wiping it around, he deposits it: “This is your seat; for Indra the Dispeller of Foes, you.” Its two stomas are alternately the threefold and fifteenfold.

18.30.380.s: gāyatrī vai chandasāṃ vi pāpmānam ahata gāyatryaiva tad yajamāno vi pāpmānam̐ hate ||
18.30.380.d: गायत्री वै छन्दसां वि पाप्मानम् अहत गायत्र्यैव तद् यजमानो वि पाप्मानँ हते ॥
18.30.380.m: The gāyatrī indeed destroyed evil among the meters; thereby the sacrificer destroys evil by the gāyatrī.

18.31.380.d: इन्द्रो ऽकामयतौद्भिद्यँ श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानां गच्छेयम् इति
18.31.380.m: Indra desired: “May I attain preeminence breaking forth among the gods.”

18.31.380.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharet tenāyajata tato vai sa audbhidyam̐ śraiṣṭhyaṃ devānām agacchat |
18.31.380.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरेत् तेनायजत ततो वै स औद्भिद्यँ श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानाम् अगच्छत् ।
18.31.380.m: He saw this sacrificial rite. He took it. He sacrificed with it. Thereupon he attained preeminence breaking forth among the gods.

18.31.380.s: yaḥ kāmayetaudbhidyam̐ śraiṣṭhyam̐ samānānāṃ gaccheyamiti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.31.380.d: यः कामयेतौद्भिद्यँ श्रैष्ठ्यँ समानानां गच्छेयमिति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.31.380.m: He who desires, 'May I attain prominent pre-eminence among my peers,' should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.
He indeed attains prominent pre-eminence among his peers.

18.31.380.s: tasyātigrāhyas | ayaṃ kṛtnur agṛbhītas | viśvajid udbhid it somaḥ | ṛṣirvipraḥ kāvyena | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvodbhide juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
18.31.380.d: तस्यातिग्राह्यस् । अयं कृत्नुर् अगृभीतस् । विश्वजिद् उद्भिद् इत् सोमः । ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वोद्भिदे जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
18.31.380.m: His atigrāhya cup is [drawn with]: 'This active, uncaptured Soma, winning all, bursting forth, a sage wise through poetic craft. You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Indra who bursts forth.'

18.31.380.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvodbhide | iti
18.31.380.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वोद्भिदे । इति
18.31.380.m: Having wiped it around, he sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra who bursts forth.'

18.31.381.m: Its two chants are the fifteenfold and the twenty-onefold, alternating.

18.31.381.s: tāḥ ṣaḍ bṛhatyas | bṛhatī vai chandasām udabhinat |
18.31.381.d: ताः षड् बृहत्यस् । बृहती वै छन्दसाम् उदभिनत् ।
18.31.381.m: These are six bṛhatī verses; the bṛhatī, indeed, burst forth among the meters.

18.31.381.s: bṛhatyaiva tad yajamāna udbhinatti | indro 'kāmayata valaṃ bhittvā paśūn sṛjeyeti
18.31.381.d: बृहत्यैव तद् यजमान उद्भिनत्ति । इन्द्रो ऽकामयत वलं भित्त्वा पशून् सृजेयेति
18.31.381.m: By means of the bṛhatī indeed the sacrificer bursts forth. 'Indra desired: May I split Vala and release the cattle.'

18.31.381.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat
18.31.381.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत्
18.31.381.m: 'He saw this sacrificial rite; he brought it;'

18.31.381.s: tenāyajata tato vai sa valaṃ bhittvā paśūn asṛjata yaḥ kāmayeta valaṃ bhittvā paśūnsṛjeyeti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.31.381.d: तेनायजत ततो वै स वलं भित्त्वा पशून् असृजत यः कामयेत वलं भित्त्वा पशून्सृजेयेति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.31.381.m: 'he sacrificed with it; then indeed, having split Vala, he released the cattle.' He who desires, 'May I split Vala and release the cattle,' should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.
Splitting Vala indeed, he releases cattle.

18.31.381.s: tasyātigrāhyas | indra oṣadhīr asanod ahāni vanaspatīm̐r asanod antarikṣam | bibheda valaṃ nunude vivācas | athābhavad damitābhikratūnām upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā valabhide juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
18.31.381.d: तस्यातिग्राह्यस् । इन्द्र ओषधीर् असनोद् अहानि वनस्पतीँर् असनोद् अन्तरिक्षम् । बिभेद वलं नुनुदे विवाचस् । अथाभवद् दमिताभिक्रतूनाम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा वलभिदे जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
18.31.381.m: His atigrāhya cup is [drawn with]: 'Indra won the plants, the days; he won the trees, the intermediate space; he split Vala, drove away the contentious; then he became the subduer of designs. You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Indra the splitter of Vala.'

18.31.381.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā valabhide | iti
18.31.381.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा वलभिदे । इति
18.31.381.m: Having wiped it around, he sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra the splitter of Vala.'
Its two chants are the seventeenfold and the twenty-onefold, alternating.

18.31.381.s: tāḥ ṣaḍ gāyatryas | gāyatrī vai chandasāṃ valam abhinat | gāyatryaiva tad yajamāno valaṃ bhittvā paśūn sṛjate ||
18.31.381.d: ताः षड् गायत्र्यस् । गायत्री वै छन्दसां वलम् अभिनत् । गायत्र्यैव तद् यजमानो वलं भित्त्वा पशून् सृजते ॥
18.31.381.m: These are six gāyatrī verses; the gāyatrī, indeed, split Vala among the meters; by means of the gāyatrī indeed the sacrificer, having split Vala, releases the cattle.

18.32.381.s: ṛtapeyena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa yad aśanānāṃ kāmayate tasyāśito bhūtvā dīkṣate yad vā labhate tasya
18.32.381.d: ऋतपेयेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स यद् अशनानां कामयते तस्याशितो भूत्वा दीक्षते यद् वा लभते तस्य
18.32.381.m: When he is about to sacrifice with the Ṛtapeya: having eaten of whatever foods he desires, he consecrates himself, or of whatever he obtains.
He does not eat for one day, then he eats.

18.32.381.s: dvyahaṃ nāśnāty athāśnāti tryahaṃ nāśnāty athāśnāti
18.32.381.d: द्व्यहं नाश्नात्य् अथाश्नाति त्र्यहं नाश्नात्य् अथाश्नाति
18.32.381.m: He does not eat for two days, then he eats; he does not eat for three days, then he eats.

18.32.381.s: so 'traiva virājam āpnoti rājānaṃ krītvohyātithyaṃ nirvapati
18.32.381.d: सो ऽत्रैव विराजम् आप्नोति राजानं क्रीत्वोह्यातिथ्यं निर्वपति
18.32.381.m: Right here he attains the virāj; having bought King [Soma], he brings [him] and pours out the oblation for the guest-reception.

18.32.382.s: yady u vā etad upātyeti caturahaṃ nāśnāty athāśnāti
18.32.382.d: यद्य् उ वा एतद् उपात्येति चतुरहं नाश्नात्य् अथाश्नाति
18.32.382.m: And if he goes beyond this: he does not eat for four days, then he eats.

18.32.382.s: pañcāhaṃ nāśnāty athāśnāti ṣaḍahaṃ nāśnāty athāśnāti tisra upasadas
18.32.382.d: पञ्चाहं नाश्नात्य् अथाश्नाति षडहं नाश्नात्य् अथाश्नाति तिस्र उपसदस्
18.32.382.m: He does not eat for five days, then he eats; he does not eat for six days, then he eats. There are three upasads.

18.32.382.s: trim̐śat saṃpadyante trim̐śadakṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyam avarunddhe |
18.32.382.d: त्रिँशत् संपद्यन्ते त्रिँशदक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यम् अवरुन्द्धे ।
18.32.382.m: They amount to thirty. The virāj has thirty syllables; the virāj is food; through the virāj he secures proper food.

18.32.382.s: atha ya ekādaśa stana evāsyai sa duha evaināṃ tena |
18.32.382.d: अथ य एकादश स्तन एवास्यै स दुह एवैनां तेन ।
18.32.382.m: Now, that which is the eleventh is indeed its teat; through that he milks it.

18.32.382.s: atha ya ekatrim̐śa stana evāsyai sa duha evaināṃ tena
18.32.382.d: अथ य एकत्रिँश स्तन एवास्यै स दुह एवैनां तेन
18.32.382.m: Now, that which is the thirty-first is indeed its teat; through that he milks it.

18.32.382.s: sa upasatsv ājyavrato bhavati śītasya sarviṣas tisṛbhir aṅgulībhir upahanty atha dvābhyām athaikayā
18.32.382.d: स उपसत्स्व् आज्यव्रतो भवति शीतस्य सर्विषस् तिसृभिर् अङ्गुलीभिर् उपहन्त्य् अथ द्वाभ्याम् अथैकया
18.32.382.m: During the upasads he has ghee as his fast-food: he takes up of cold clarified butter with three fingers, then with two, then with one.

18.32.382.s: śītasya vaiva sarpiṣas tribhiḥ parvabhir upahanty atha dvābhyām athaikena
18.32.382.d: शीतस्य वैव सर्पिषस् त्रिभिः पर्वभिर् उपहन्त्य् अथ द्वाभ्याम् अथैकेन
18.32.382.m: Or of cold clarified butter he takes up with three finger-joints, then with two, then with one.

18.32.382.s: vilīne vā sarpiṣi trīṇi parūm̐ṣy avadadhāty atha dve athaikaṃ tristanadvistanaikastanavratasya rūpāṇi kurvan
18.32.382.d: विलीने वा सर्पिषि त्रीणि परूँष्य् अवदधात्य् अथ द्वे अथैकं त्रिस्तनद्विस्तनैकस्तनव्रतस्य रूपाणि कुर्वन्
18.32.382.m: Or in melted clarified butter he dips three finger-joints, then two, then one, making the forms of the three-teat, two-teat, and one-teat fast-food.

18.32.382.s: sa nādityād divā paryāvartate nāgner adhi naktam audumbaraḥ somacamasaś catuḥsraktis |
18.32.382.d: स नादित्याद् दिवा पर्यावर्तते नाग्नेर् अधि नक्तम् औदुम्बरः सोमचमसश् चतुःस्रक्तिस् ।
18.32.382.m: He does not turn away from the sun by day, nor from the fire by night. There is an audumbara soma-goblet with four corners.

18.33.382.s: saptadaśa stomo bhavati saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpatim annādyaṃ nopānamat
18.33.382.d: सप्तदश स्तोमो भवति सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः प्रजापतिम् अन्नाद्यं नोपानमत्
18.33.382.m: The chant is seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold. Proper food did not yield to Prajāpati.

18.33.382.s: taṃ devā ṛtasatyābhyām anvaiṣuḥ sa yad aśnāti yad evāśanenāvaruddhaṃ tasyāvaruddhyā iti tat |
18.33.382.d: तं देवा ऋतसत्याभ्याम् अन्वैषुः स यद् अश्नाति यद् एवाशनेनावरुद्धं तस्यावरुद्ध्या इति तत् ।
18.33.382.m: The gods sought it by means of cosmic order and truth. In that he eats, [it is] with the thought: 'For the securing of whatever is secured by eating.'

18.33.382.s: atha yan nāśnāti yad evānaśanenāvaruddhaṃ tasyāvaruddhyā iti tat |
18.33.382.d: अथ यन् नाश्नाति यद् एवानशनेनावरुद्धं तस्यावरुद्ध्या इति तत् ।
18.33.382.m: Then, in that he does not eat, [it is] with the thought: 'For the securing of whatever is secured by fasting.'

18.33.382.s: atha yad upasatsv ājyavrato bhavaty etad vai devānāṃ priyaṃ dhāma yad ājyam |
18.33.382.d: अथ यद् उपसत्स्व् आज्यव्रतो भवत्य् एतद् वै देवानां प्रियं धाम यद् आज्यम् ।
18.33.382.m: Then, in that he has ghee as his fast-food during the upasads: ghee is indeed the dear abode of the gods.

18.33.382.s: devānām eva priyaṃ dhāmāvarunddha iti tat |
18.33.382.d: देवानाम् एव प्रियं धामावरुन्द्ध इति तत् ।
18.33.382.m: [It is] with the thought: 'He secures the dear abode of the gods.'

18.33.382.s: atha yan nādityād divā paryāvartate nāgner adhi naktam ete vai devānām ṛtasatye
18.33.382.d: अथ यन् नादित्याद् दिवा पर्यावर्तते नाग्नेर् अधि नक्तम् एते वै देवानाम् ऋतसत्ये
18.33.382.m: Then, in that he does not turn away from the sun by day, nor from the fire by night: these two indeed are cosmic order and truth among the gods.

18.33.383.s: ned devānām ṛtasatye pṛṣṭhataḥ karavāṇīta tat |
18.33.383.d: नेद् देवानाम् ऋतसत्ये पृष्ठतः करवाणीत तत् ।
18.33.383.m: [It is] with the thought: 'Lest I turn my back on the cosmic order and truth of the gods.'

18.33.383.s: atha yad audumbaro bhavaty ūrg vā annādyam udumbaras | ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyā iti tat |
18.33.383.d: अथ यद् औदुम्बरो भवत्य् ऊर्ग् वा अन्नाद्यम् उदुम्बरस् । ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्या इति तत् ।
18.33.383.m: Then, in that it is of udumbara wood: udumbara is vigor, proper food; [it is] with the thought: 'For the securing of vigor, of proper food.'

18.33.383.s: atha yat somacamaso bhavati | etad vai devānāṃ paramam annaṃ yat somaḥ
18.33.383.d: अथ यत् सोमचमसो भवति । एतद् वै देवानां परमम् अन्नं यत् सोमः
18.33.383.m: Then, in that there is a soma-goblet: 'Soma is indeed the highest food of the gods.'
[It is] with the thought: 'By the highest proper food he secures lower proper food for him.'

18.33.383.s: atha yac catuḥsraktir bhavati yad eva diśo 'nnādyaṃ prāviśat tasyāvaruddhyā iti tat |
18.33.383.d: अथ यच् चतुःस्रक्तिर् भवति यद् एव दिशो ऽन्नाद्यं प्राविशत् तस्यावरुद्ध्या इति तत् ।
18.33.383.m: Then, in that it is four-cornered, [it is] with the thought: 'For the securing of whatever proper food entered the directions.'

18.33.383.s: atha yat trivedā bhavati na hy etām ekavedā dakṣiṇām udyantum arhatīti tat |
18.33.383.d: अथ यत् त्रिवेदा भवति न ह्य् एताम् एकवेदा दक्षिणाम् उद्यन्तुम् अर्हतीति तत् ।
18.33.383.m: Then, in that the sacrificial fee is three Vedas, [it is] with the thought: 'One who knows one Veda is not worthy to lift up this sacrificial fee.'

18.33.383.s: atha yat sagotro bhavaty ātmā vai sagotra ātmann eva yajñasya yaśo 'nnādyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayānīti tat ||
18.33.383.d: अथ यत् सगोत्रो भवत्य् आत्मा वै सगोत्र आत्मन्न् एव यज्ञस्य यशो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रतिष्ठापयानीति तत् ॥
18.33.383.m: Then, in that he belongs to the same lineage: one of the same lineage is indeed oneself; [it is] with the thought: 'May I establish the glory, the proper food of the sacrifice in myself.'

18.34.383.s: taṃ mādhyaṃdinīyaiś camasaiḥ sahonnīya juhvati tam ṛtvijo hutaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ kāle brahmaṇa upātidiśanti
18.34.383.d: तं माध्यंदिनीयैश् चमसैः सहोन्नीय जुह्वति तम् ऋत्विजो हुतं दक्षिणानां काले ब्रह्मण उपातिदिशन्ति
18.34.383.m: Having drawn it together with the midday goblets, they offer it; the officiating priests, when it is offered, assign it to the brahman priest at the time of the sacrificial fees.

18.34.383.s: taṃ brahmaṇaḥ santaṃ paryupaviśya bhakṣayanti yad ṛtaṃ manyante tena
18.34.383.d: तं ब्रह्मणः सन्तं पर्युपविश्य भक्षयन्ति यद् ऋतं मन्यन्ते तेन
18.34.383.m: Sitting around it while it belongs to the brahman priest, they consume it by means of whatever they regard as cosmic order.
Because they consume it by cosmic order, that is the nature of the Ṛtapeya as Ṛtapeya.

18.34.383.s: diśo 'kāmayantānnādyaḥ syāmānnādyam avarundhīmahy annādyam asmāsu pratitiṣṭhed iti
18.34.383.d: दिशो ऽकामयन्तान्नाद्यः स्यामान्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धीमह्य् अन्नाद्यम् अस्मासु प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति
18.34.383.m: 'The directions desired: May we be eaters of food; may we secure proper food; may proper food be established in us.'

18.34.383.s: tam āharan tenāyajanta tato vai tā annādyo 'bhavann annādyam avārundhatānnādyam āsu pratyatiṣṭhat |
18.34.383.d: तम् आहरन् तेनायजन्त ततो वै ता अन्नाद्यो ऽभवन्न् अन्नाद्यम् अवारुन्धतान्नाद्यम् आसु प्रत्यतिष्ठत् ।
18.34.383.m: 'They brought it; they sacrificed with it; then indeed they became eaters of food, they secured proper food, proper food was established in them.'

18.34.383.s: yaḥ kāmayetānnādī me prajā syād annādyam avarundhītānnādyam asyāṃ pratitiṣṭhed iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.34.383.d: यः कामयेतान्नादी मे प्रजा स्याद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धीतान्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.34.383.m: He who desires, 'May my offspring be an eater of food, may it secure proper food, may proper food be established in it,' should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.

18.34.383.s: annādy evāsya prajā bhavaty annādyam avarunddhe 'nnādyam asyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati
18.34.383.d: अन्नाद्य् एवास्य प्रजा भवत्य् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्द्धे ऽन्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रतितिष्ठति
18.34.383.m: His offspring indeed becomes an eater of food, it secures proper food, proper food is established in it.

18.34.383.s: tasya catasṛṣu bahiṣpavamāno 'ṣṭāsvaṣṭāsv ājyāni dvādaśo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ ṣoḍaśāni pṛṣṭhāni savim̐śa ārbhavaḥ pavamānaś caturvim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma
18.34.383.d: तस्य चतसृषु बहिष्पवमानो ऽष्टास्वष्टास्व् आज्यानि द्वादशो माध्यंदिनः पवमानः षोडशानि पृष्ठानि सविँश आर्भवः पवमानश् चतुर्विँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम
18.34.383.m: Its bahiṣpavamāna chant is on four [verses], the ājya chants on eight each, the midday pavamāna chant is twelvefold, the pṛṣṭha chants are sixteenfold, the ārbhava pavamāna chant is twentyfold, and the agniṣṭoma saman is twenty-fourfold.

18.34.384.m: They call it the fourfold chant of the directions.

18.34.384.s: chandām̐sy akāmayanta yaśo 'śnuvīmahi yaśo 'varundhīmahi yaśo 'smāsu pratitiṣṭhed iti
18.34.384.d: छन्दाँस्य् अकामयन्त यशो ऽश्नुवीमहि यशो ऽवरुन्धीमहि यशो ऽस्मासु प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति
18.34.384.m: The meters desired: 'May we attain glory; may we secure glory; may glory be established in us.'

18.34.384.s: tam āharan tenāyajanta tato vai tāni yaśo 'śnuvata yaśo 'vārundhata yaśa eṣu pratyatiṣṭhat |
18.34.384.d: तम् आहरन् तेनायजन्त ततो वै तानि यशो ऽश्नुवत यशो ऽवारुन्धत यश एषु प्रत्यतिष्ठत् ।
18.34.384.m: They brought it; they sacrificed with it; then indeed they attained glory, they secured glory, glory was established in them.

18.34.384.s: yaḥ kāmayeta yaśo 'śnuvīya yaśo 'varundhīya yaśo mayi pratitiṣṭhed iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.34.384.d: यः कामयेत यशो ऽश्नुवीय यशो ऽवरुन्धीय यशो मयि प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.34.384.m: He who desires, 'May I attain glory, may I secure glory, may glory be established in me,' should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.

18.34.384.d: यश एवाश्नुते यशो ऽवरुन्द्धे यशो ऽस्मिन् प्रतितिष्ठति
18.34.384.m: He indeed attains glory, he secures glory, glory is established in him.

18.34.384.s: tasya stomā astuvataikasyām atha tisṛṣv ekasyām atha tisṛṣu tam etaṃ chandasām ekatrika ity ācakṣate
18.34.384.d: तस्य स्तोमा अस्तुवतैकस्याम् अथ तिसृष्व् एकस्याम् अथ तिसृषु तम् एतं छन्दसाम् एकत्रिक इत्य् आचक्षते
18.34.384.m: Its chants praised on one verse, then on three, on one, then on three; this they call the one-and-threefold chant of the meters.

18.34.384.s: tasya stomās trivṛd atha trayaḥ pañcadaśās trivṛd atha trayaḥ saptadaśās trivṛd atha traya ekavim̐śās
18.34.384.d: तस्य स्तोमास् त्रिवृद् अथ त्रयः पञ्चदशास् त्रिवृद् अथ त्रयः सप्तदशास् त्रिवृद् अथ त्रय एकविँशास्
18.34.384.m: Its chants are: the threefold, then three fifteenfold; the threefold, then three seventeenfold; the threefold, then three twenty-onefold.

18.34.384.s: tam etam̐ stomānām ekatrika ity ācakṣate ||
18.34.384.d: तम् एतँ स्तोमानाम् एकत्रिक इत्य् आचक्षते ॥
18.34.384.m: This [sacrifice] of stomas they call the Ekatrika.

18.35.384.s: indrāgnī vā akāmayetām̐ samānalokau syāva samānaṃ lokam iyāveti
18.35.384.d: इन्द्राग्नी वा अकामयेताँ समानलोकौ स्याव समानं लोकम् इयावेति
18.35.384.m: “Indra and Agni desired: ‘May we be of the same world; may we go to the same world.’”

18.35.384.s: tāv etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyatām | tam āharatām | tenāyajetām |
18.35.384.d: ताव् एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यताम् । तम् आहरताम् । तेनायजेताम् ।
18.35.384.m: “They saw this sacrificial rite; / they brought it; / they sacrificed with it.”

18.35.384.s: tato vai tau samānalokāv abhavatām̐ samānaṃ lokam aitām̐ samānalokāv api |
18.35.384.d: ततो वै तौ समानलोकाव् अभवताँ समानं लोकम् ऐताँ समानलोकाव् अपि ।
18.35.384.m: “Then indeed they became of the same world; they went to the same world; they reached the same world.”

18.35.384.s: atha yau kāmayetām̐ rājā ca purohitaś ca samānalokau syāva samānaṃ lokam iyāveti tāv etena yajñakratunā yajeyātām̐ samānalokāv eva bhavataḥ samānaṃ lokam itas |
18.35.384.d: अथ यौ कामयेताँ राजा च पुरोहितश् च समानलोकौ स्याव समानं लोकम् इयावेति ताव् एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेयाताँ समानलोकाव् एव भवतः समानं लोकम् इतस् ।
18.35.384.m: Now, if a king and a domestic priest desire: ‘May we be of the same world; may we go to the same world,’ they should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite; they indeed become of the same world; they go to the same world.

18.35.385.s: aśvaratho yajñāyudhaḥ prāsaṅgyaś camasaḥ sā brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇā | aśvatarīrathaḥ sarvāyudho 'prāsaṅgyaḥ kām̐syastūṇībandhaḥ sā rājanyasya dakṣiṇā
18.35.385.d: अश्वरथो यज्ञायुधः प्रासङ्ग्यश् चमसः सा ब्राह्मणस्य दक्षिणा । अश्वतरीरथः सर्वायुधो ऽप्रासङ्ग्यः काँस्यस्तूणीबन्धः सा राजन्यस्य दक्षिणा
18.35.385.m: A horse-chariot, sacrificial weapons, a draught-ox harness, and a wooden cup—that is the sacrificial gift for the brāhmaṇa. / A mule-chariot, all kinds of weapons, a non-draught yoke, and a bronze quiver-fastener—that is the sacrificial gift for the rājanya.

18.35.385.s: tasya trivṛt pañcadaśau viparyāsam̐ stomau bhavatas trivṛd eva brāhmaṇasya pañcadaśo rājanyasya
18.35.385.d: तस्य त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशौ विपर्यासँ स्तोमौ भवतस् त्रिवृद् एव ब्राह्मणस्य पञ्चदशो राजन्यस्य
18.35.385.m: Its two stomas are the Trivṛt and the Pañcadaśa alternating: / the Trivṛt belongs to the brāhmaṇa, the Pañcadaśa to the rājanya.

18.35.385.s: tam etam indrāgniyoḥ kulāya ity ācakṣate |
18.35.385.d: तम् एतम् इन्द्राग्नियोः कुलाय इत्य् आचक्षते ।
18.35.385.m: This they call the Kulāya of Indra and Agni.

18.35.385.s: eṣa eva san pitāputrīya eṣa sakhyor yajña eṣa bhrātroḥ ||
18.35.385.d: एष एव सन् पितापुत्रीय एष सख्योर् यज्ञ एष भ्रात्रोः ॥
18.35.385.m: This same [sacrifice] is the Pitāputrīya; this is the sacrifice of two friends; this is of two brothers.

18.36.385.s: abhicaraṇīyaiḥ somair yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa dvayāni yajñāyudhāny upakalpayate bādhakāni ca tailvakāni ca śavānaso 'dhiṣavaṇe phalake puruṣāsthasya vṛṣaṇau
18.36.385.d: अभिचरणीयैः सोमैर् यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स द्वयानि यज्ञायुधान्य् उपकल्पयते बाधकानि च तैल्वकानि च शवानसो ऽधिषवणे फलके पुरुषास्थस्य वृषणौ
18.36.385.m: When he is about to sacrifice with the malevolent soma rites, / he prepares two sets of sacrificial implements: those of bādhaka wood and those of tilvaka wood; the two pressing-boards are made from a corpse-cart, and the two testicles of human bone.

18.36.385.s: sa yatrādhvaryurupām̐śuṃ grahīṣyanrājānamabhiṣuṇoti tasya yo 'm̐śuḥ parāpatati tam etasmin pātra ādhāyopasaṃgṛhyāthāha | amuṃ jahy atha tvā hoṣyāmi | iti |
18.36.385.d: स यत्राध्वर्युरुपाँशुं ग्रहीष्यन्राजानमभिषुणोति तस्य यो ऽँशुः परापतति तम् एतस्मिन् पात्र आधायोपसंगृह्याथाह । अमुं जह्य् अथ त्वा होष्यामि । इति ।
18.36.385.m: When the adhvaryu priest, about to draw the upāṃśu cup, presses the soma, whatever stalk flies off from it, having placed it in this vessel and grasping it, he then says: ‘Kill so-and-so, and then I will offer you!’

18.36.385.s: athaitaṃ bhaṅgam āhavanīye 'nupraharati | idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇaṃ pariplunā bhaṅgena vidhyāmi | iti |
18.36.385.d: अथैतं भङ्गम् आहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति । इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणं परिप्लुना भङ्गेन विध्यामि । इति ।
18.36.385.m: Then he throws this fragment into the āhavanīya fire with: ‘Here I pierce so-and-so, son of so-and-so, with this floating fragment!’

18.36.385.s: atra yaṃ yajamāno dveṣṭi taṃ manasā dhyāyati |
18.36.385.d: अत्र यं यजमानो द्वेष्टि तं मनसा ध्यायति ।
18.36.385.m: Here, whomever the sacrificer hates, he meditates upon him in his mind.

18.36.386.s: athaitat pātraṃ khare yathāyatanam̐ sādayati | amuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmi | iti
18.36.386.d: अथैतत् पात्रं खरे यथायतनँ सादयति । अमुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामि । इति
18.36.386.m: Then he sets down this vessel in its proper place on the mound with: ‘I set you down in the breath of so-and-so!’

18.36.386.s: sa yaṃ kaṃ ca grahaṃ gṛhṇāty evam evainaṃ gṛhṇāti
18.36.386.d: स यं कं च ग्रहं गृह्णात्य् एवम् एवैनं गृह्णाति
18.36.386.m: Whatever soma-cup he draws, he draws it in this very manner.

18.36.386.s: yad u kiṃ ca pātram̐ sādayaty evam evainat sādayati sa eṣa trivṛdagniṣṭoma ekastoma ekahavirdhānas
18.36.386.d: यद् उ किं च पात्रँ सादयत्य् एवम् एवैनत् सादयति स एष त्रिवृदग्निष्टोम एकस्तोम एकहविर्धानस्
18.36.386.m: Whatever vessel he sets down, he sets it down in this very manner. / That is a Trivṛt-Agniṣṭoma, with a single stoma and a single havirdhāna shed.

18.36.386.s: atheṣuḥ samānam abhicaraṇīyam̐ śilpam | tisṛṣutisṛṣu stuvate
18.36.386.d: अथेषुः समानम् अभिचरणीयँ शिल्पम् । तिसृषुतिसृषु स्तुवते
18.36.386.m: Now the Iṣu: / the malevolent ritual art is the same; / they chant on three [verses] each.

18.36.386.s: ratho havirdhānam atha saṃdam̐śaḥ samānam abhicaraṇīyam̐ śilpam |
18.36.386.d: रथो हविर्धानम् अथ संदँशः समानम् अभिचरणीयँ शिल्पम् ।
18.36.386.m: A chariot is the havirdhāna shed. / Now the Saṃdaṃśa: / the malevolent ritual art is the same.

18.36.386.s: dvau trayastrim̐śau madhyata stomau bhavatas | dve havirdhāne
18.36.386.d: द्वौ त्रयस्त्रिँशौ मध्यत स्तोमौ भवतस् । द्वे हविर्धाने
18.36.386.m: There are two Trayastriṃśa stomas in the middle; / there are two havirdhāna sheds.

18.36.386.s: athendravajraḥ samānam abhicaraṇīyam̐ śilpam | pañcadaśa eṣa bhavati ||
18.36.386.d: अथेन्द्रवज्रः समानम् अभिचरणीयँ शिल्पम् । पञ्चदश एष भवति ॥
18.36.386.m: Now the Indravajra: / the malevolent ritual art is the same; / it has the Pañcadaśa [stoma].

18.37.386.s: duraśena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate ṣaṣṭim̐ śatamānāni hiraṇyāni trim̐śatam̐ suvarṇāni trim̐śatam̐ rajatāni bahv anyad dhiraṇyam |
18.37.386.d: दुरशेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते षष्टिँ शतमानानि हिरण्यानि त्रिँशतँ सुवर्णानि त्रिँशतँ रजतानि बह्व् अन्यद् धिरण्यम् ।
18.37.386.m: When one is about to sacrifice with the Duraśa, / he prepares sixty śatamānas of gold: thirty of gold, thirty of silver, and much other gold.

18.37.386.s: sa āmāvāsyena haviṣeṣṭvā sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapati
18.37.386.d: स आमावास्येन हविषेष्ट्वा सौर्यं चरुं निर्वपति
18.37.386.m: Having sacrificed with the oblation of the new moon ritual, he offers a mess of boiled rice to Sūrya.

18.37.386.s: tasmin suvarṇam̐ śatamānaṃ dadāti | atha sāyam̐ hute 'gnihotre cāndramasaṃ caruṃ nirvapati
18.37.386.d: तस्मिन् सुवर्णँ शतमानं ददाति । अथ सायँ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे चान्द्रमसं चरुं निर्वपति
18.37.386.m: At that, he gives a gold śatamāna. / Then, in the evening, when the agnihotra has been offered, he offers a mess of boiled rice to Candramas.
At that, he gives a silver śatamāna.

18.37.386.s: sa evam evaitābhyām iṣṭibhyām aharahar yajamāno māsam eti | atha dīkṣate
18.37.386.d: स एवम् एवैताभ्याम् इष्टिभ्याम् अहरहर् यजमानो मासम् एति । अथ दीक्षते
18.37.386.m: Sacrificing day after day in this manner with these two iṣṭis, he proceeds for a month; / then he undergoes the consecration.
At the dīkṣaṇīyā offering, he gives gold weighing twelve mānas.

18.37.387.s: prāyaṇīyāyāṃ caturvim̐śatimānaṃ dadāti | ātithyāyāṃ dve caturvim̐śatimāne dadāti
18.37.387.d: प्रायणीयायां चतुर्विँशतिमानं ददाति । आतिथ्यायां द्वे चतुर्विँशतिमाने ददाति
18.37.387.m: At the prāyaṇīyā offering, he gives [gold] weighing twenty-four mānas; / at the ātithyā offering, he gives two [pieces] weighing twenty-four mānas.
At the first upasad, he gives four;

18.37.387.s: dvitīyasyām upasady aṣṭau dadāti tṛtīyasyām upasadi ṣoḍaśa dadāti
18.37.387.d: द्वितीयस्याम् उपसद्य् अष्टौ ददाति तृतीयस्याम् उपसदि षोडश ददाति
18.37.387.m: at the second upasad, he gives eight; / at the third upasad, he gives sixteen;

18.37.387.s: caturthyām upasadi dvātrim̐śataṃ dadāti pañcamyām upasadi catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ dadāti
18.37.387.d: चतुर्थ्याम् उपसदि द्वात्रिँशतं ददाति पञ्चम्याम् उपसदि चतुःषष्टिं ददाति
18.37.387.m: at the fourth upasad, he gives thirty-two; / at the fifth upasad, he gives sixty-four;

18.37.387.s: ṣaṣṭhyām upasady aṣṭāvim̐śam̐ śataṃ caturvim̐śatimānānāṃ dadāti |
18.37.387.d: षष्ठ्याम् उपसद्य् अष्टाविँशँ शतं चतुर्विँशतिमानानां ददाति ।
18.37.387.m: at the sixth upasad, he gives one hundred and twenty-eight [pieces] weighing twenty-four mānas.

18.37.387.s: athātaḥ śatasaṃkhyaiva | agnīṣomīyasya hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ dve śate dadāti |
18.37.387.d: अथातः शतसंख्यैव । अग्नीषोमीयस्य हुतायां वपायां द्वे शते ददाति ।
18.37.387.m: From then on, the counting is by hundreds: / when the omentum of the victim for Agni and Soma is offered, he gives two hundred;
when the omentum of the victim for Agni is offered, he gives four [hundred];

18.37.387.s: prātaḥsavanīyeṣv aṣṭau dadāti mādhyaṃdinīyeṣu ṣoḍaśa dadāti
18.37.387.d: प्रातःसवनीयेष्व् अष्टौ ददाति माध्यंदिनीयेषु षोडश ददाति
18.37.387.m: at the morning-pressing victims, he gives eight [hundred]; / at the midday victims, he gives sixteen [hundred];

18.37.387.s: dakṣiṇānāṃ kāle dvātrim̐śataṃ dadāti tṛtīyasavanīyeṣu catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ dadāti |
18.37.387.d: दक्षिणानां काले द्वात्रिँशतं ददाति तृतीयसवनीयेषु चतुःषष्टिं ददाति ।
18.37.387.m: at the time of the sacrificial gifts, he gives thirty-two [hundred]; / at the third-pressing victims, he gives sixty-four [hundred];

18.37.387.s: anūbandhyasya hutāyāṃ vapāyām aṣṭāvim̐śam̐ śatānāṃ dadāti
18.37.387.d: अनूबन्ध्यस्य हुतायां वपायाम् अष्टाविँशँ शतानां ददाति
18.37.387.m: when the omentum of the anūbandhyā victim is offered, he gives one hundred and twenty-eight hundreds.

18.37.387.s: sa yad etābhyām iṣṭibhyām aharahar yajate sūryācandramasor eva tat sāyujyam̐ salokatām āpnoti ||
18.37.387.d: स यद् एताभ्याम् इष्टिभ्याम् अहरहर् यजते सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर् एव तत् सायुज्यँ सलोकताम् आप्नोति ॥
18.37.387.m: Because he sacrifices day after day with these two iṣṭis, he thereby attains union and co-residence with the sun and moon.

18.38.387.s: atha yad dhiraṇyadakṣiṇo bhavati hiraṇmayam eva tad yajamāna ātmānam̐ sam̐skurute
18.38.387.d: अथ यद् धिरण्यदक्षिणो भवति हिरण्मयम् एव तद् यजमान आत्मानँ सँस्कुरुते
18.38.387.m: Now, because his sacrificial gifts consist of gold, the sacrificer thereby refines himself as golden.

18.38.388.s: tasya yad ūrdhvaṃ nābhes tat suvarṇam avāṅ rajatam |
18.38.388.d: तस्य यद् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस् तत् सुवर्णम् अवाङ् रजतम् ।
18.38.388.m: What is above his navel is gold, what is below is silver.

18.38.388.s: yadā ha vai hiraṇmayo bhavaty athāmṛto bhavati
18.38.388.d: यदा ह वै हिरण्मयो भवत्य् अथामृतो भवति
18.38.388.m: When indeed he becomes golden, then he becomes immortal.

18.38.388.s: hiraṇmayā ha vai devās tasmāt te 'mṛtāḥ saptadaśastomo bhavati
18.38.388.d: हिरण्मया ह वै देवास् तस्मात् ते ऽमृताः सप्तदशस्तोमो भवति
18.38.388.m: The gods are indeed golden; / therefore they are immortal. / The stoma is the Saptadaśa.

18.38.388.s: saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai | ubhe sāmanī bhavatas | chandomayāv etat pakṣau yajamāna ātmānam̐ sam̐skurute |
18.38.388.d: सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः प्रजापतेर् आप्त्यै । उभे सामनी भवतस् । छन्दोमयाव् एतत् पक्षौ यजमान आत्मानँ सँस्कुरुते ।
18.38.388.m: Prajāpati is seventeenfold; / [this is] for obtaining Prajāpati. / There are both samans; / the sacrificer refines himself with two wings consisting of the meters,

18.38.388.s: sa yad etena yajñakratunā yajate sūryācandramasor eva tat sāyujyam̐ salokatāṃ jayati
18.38.388.d: स यद् एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजते सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर् एव तत् सायुज्यँ सलोकतां जयति
18.38.388.m: Because he sacrifices with this sacrificial rite, he wins union and co-residence with the sun and moon.

18.38.388.s: tena duraśas | duraśa iva hy etayor devatayor lokas |
18.38.388.d: तेन दुरशस् । दुरश इव ह्य् एतयोर् देवतयोर् लोकस् ।
18.38.388.m: Because of that, it is [called] Duraśa; / for difficult to attain (duraśa), as it were, is the world of these two deities.

18.38.388.s: atha durṇāśena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate 'naḍucchataṃ ca trayastrim̐śataṃ ca niṣkān |
18.38.388.d: अथ दुर्णाशेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते ऽनडुच्छतं च त्रयस्त्रिँशतं च निष्कान् ।
18.38.388.m: Now, when one is about to sacrifice with the Durṇāśa, / he prepares a hundred draft-oxen and thirty-three gold coins (niṣkas).
By this he wins the world of the draft-ox.
By this he wins the luminous world.

18.38.388.s: tena haitena jyotiṣo 'dhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati saptadaśastomo bhavati
18.38.388.d: तेन हैतेन ज्योतिषो ऽधि स्वर्गं लोकं जयति सप्तदशस्तोमो भवति
18.38.388.m: By this he wins the heavenly world beyond the light. / The stoma is the Saptadaśa.

18.38.388.s: saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai | ubhe sāmanī bhavatas |
18.38.388.d: सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः प्रजापतेर् आप्त्यै । उभे सामनी भवतस् ।
18.38.388.m: Prajāpati is seventeenfold; / [this is] for obtaining Prajāpati. / There are both samans.

18.38.388.s: chandomayāv evaitat pakṣau yajamāna ātmānam̐ sam̐skurute |
18.38.388.d: छन्दोमयाव् एवैतत् पक्षौ यजमान आत्मानँ सँस्कुरुते ।
18.38.388.m: The sacrificer refines himself with two wings consisting of the meters,

18.38.388.s: etasya lokasya jityai sa yad etena yajñakratuneṣṭvā na naśyati tena durṇāśas
18.38.388.d: एतस्य लोकस्य जित्यै स यद् एतेन यज्ञक्रतुनेष्ट्वा न नश्यति तेन दुर्णाशस्
18.38.388.m: for winning this world. / Because, having sacrificed with this sacrificial rite, he does not perish (na naśyati), it is therefore [called] Durṇāśa.

18.38.389.s: tad durṇāśasya durṇāśatvam | keśī ha dālbhyo 'pacitikāmo 'pacitineje tan no nāmanī pariharantā iti
18.38.389.d: तद् दुर्णाशस्य दुर्णाशत्वम् । केशी ह दाल्भ्यो ऽपचितिकामो ऽपचितिनेजे तन् नो नामनी परिहरन्ता इति
18.38.389.m: That is the durṇāśa-nature of the Durṇāśa. / “Keśin Dālbhya, desirous of honor, sacrificed with the Apaciti: ‘Let them avoid our names!’”

18.38.389.s: tato ha vā etat pañcālarājānāṃ nāmāni pariharante ||
18.38.389.d: ततो ह वा एतत् पञ्चालराजानां नामानि परिहरन्ते ॥
18.38.389.m: “Thence indeed they avoid the names of the Pañcāla kings.”

18.39.389.s: śīrṣaṇyā iti keśān ācakṣate kuśā iti darbhān nadyāv iti gaireyakavimatyau
18.39.389.d: शीर्षण्या इति केशान् आचक्षते कुशा इति दर्भान् नद्याव् इति गैरेयकविमत्यौ
18.39.389.m: “They call hair ‘head-growths’; / darbha grass they call ‘kuśa’; / the Gaireyakī and Vimatyā they call ‘the two rivers’.”

18.39.389.s: tato vai so 'pacitimān abhavat | yaḥ kāmayetāpacitimānt syām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.39.389.d: ततो वै सो ऽपचितिमान् अभवत् । यः कामयेतापचितिमान्त् स्याम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.39.389.m: “Thence indeed he became honored. / Whoever should desire: ‘May I become honored,’ should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite;”

18.39.389.s: tasya caturvim̐śo bahiṣpavamānas trivṛt pañcadaśāny ājyāni
18.39.389.d: तस्य चतुर्विँशो बहिष्पवमानस् त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि
18.39.389.m: Its Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-versed; the Ājya stotras are the Trivṛt and Pañcadaśa.

18.39.389.s: tās tisro gāyatryas | caturvim̐śo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ pañcadaśasaptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni
18.39.389.d: तास् तिस्रो गायत्र्यस् । चतुर्विँशो माध्यंदिनः पवमानः पञ्चदशसप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि
18.39.389.m: These are three Gāyatrī verses. / The midday Pavamāna chant is twenty-four-fold; the Pṛṣṭha stotras are fifteen-fold and seventeen-fold.

18.39.389.s: te dve triṣṭubhau triṇava ārbhavaḥ pavamāna ekavim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma
18.39.389.d: ते द्वे त्रिष्टुभौ त्रिणव आर्भवः पवमान एकविँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम
18.39.389.m: They are two Triṣṭubh verses. / The Ārbhava Pavamāna chant is twenty-seven-fold; the Agniṣṭoma saman is twenty-one-fold.

18.39.389.s: saikā jagatī | etāni vai chandasām apacitatamāni |
18.39.389.d: सैका जगती । एतानि वै छन्दसाम् अपचिततमानि ।
18.39.389.m: It is one Jagatī verse. / These indeed are the most honored of the metres.

18.39.389.s: apacitimān eva bhavati ya evaṃ veda | asāv ādityo 'kāmayata tviṣimānt syām iti
18.39.389.d: अपचितिमान् एव भवति य एवं वेद । असाव् आदित्यो ऽकामयत त्विषिमान्त् स्याम् इति
18.39.389.m: He indeed becomes honored who knows thus. / "Yonder sun desired: 'May I be resplendent!'"

18.39.389.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata
18.39.389.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत
18.39.389.m: "He saw this sacrificial rite; he took it; he sacrificed with it."

18.39.390.s: tato vai sa tviṣimān abhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta tviṣimānt syām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.39.390.d: ततो वै स त्विषिमान् अभवत् । यः कामयेत त्विषिमान्त् स्याम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.39.390.m: "Then indeed he became resplendent." / "Whoever might desire, 'May I be resplendent,' he should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite."

18.39.390.s: tviṣimān eva bhavati tasya sauryo 'tigrāhyaḥ sauryaḥ paśur upālambhyas |
18.39.390.d: त्विषिमान् एव भवति तस्य सौर्यो ऽतिग्राह्यः सौर्यः पशुर् उपालम्भ्यस् ।
18.39.390.m: "He indeed becomes resplendent." / For it, there is an extra cup for Sūrya; a victim dedicated to Sūrya is to be seized.

18.40.390.s: indro 'kāmayatarṣabha iva paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ devānāṃ parīyām iti
18.40.390.d: इन्द्रो ऽकामयतर्षभ इव पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं देवानां परीयाम् इति
18.40.390.m: "Indra desired: 'Like a bull among beasts, may I attain lordship, supremacy, and sovereignty over the gods!'"

18.40.390.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata
18.40.390.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत
18.40.390.m: "He saw this sacrificial rite; he took it; he sacrificed with it."

18.40.390.s: tato vai sa ṛṣabha iva paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ devānāṃ paryait |
18.40.390.d: ततो वै स ऋषभ इव पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं देवानां पर्यैत् ।
18.40.390.m: "Then indeed, like a bull among beasts, he attained lordship, supremacy, and sovereignty over the gods."

18.40.390.s: yaḥ kāmayetarṣabha iva paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyam̐ samānānāṃ parīyām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.40.390.d: यः कामयेतर्षभ इव पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यँ समानानां परीयाम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.40.390.m: "Whoever might desire: 'Like a bull among beasts, may I attain lordship, supremacy, and sovereignty over my equals,' he should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite."

18.40.390.s: ṛṣabha iva paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyam̐ samānānāṃ paryeti
18.40.390.d: ऋषभ इव पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यँ समानानां पर्येति
18.40.390.m: "Like a bull among beasts, he attains lordship, supremacy, and sovereignty over his equals."

18.40.390.s: tasyātigrāhyas | vṛṣā so am̐śuḥ pavate haviṣmānt somas | indrasya bhāga ṛtayuḥ śatāyuḥ | sa mā vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ kṛṇotu priyaṃ viśām̐ sarvavīram̐ suvīram upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvarṣabhāya juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇām | iti
18.40.390.d: तस्यातिग्राह्यस् । वृषा सो अँशुः पवते हविष्मान्त् सोमस् । इन्द्रस्य भाग ऋतयुः शतायुः । स मा वृषाणं वृषभं कृणोतु प्रियं विशाँ सर्ववीरँ सुवीरम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वर्षभाय जुष्टं गृह्णाम् । इति
18.40.390.m: Its extra cup [is taken with]: "The vigorous shoot purifies itself, the oblational soma, / Indra's portion, observing cosmic order, living a hundred years; / may it make me a vigorous bull, / dear to the people, having all heroes, having good heroes. / You are taken with a base; I take you agreeable to Indra the bull!"

18.40.390.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvarṣabhāya | iti
18.40.390.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वर्षभाय । इति
18.40.390.m: Having wiped it around, he sets it down with: "This is your womb; for Indra the bull!"

18.40.390.s: tasya pañcadaśasya sata ekavim̐śam̐ hotuḥ prṣṭhaṃ kakudo rūpam
18.40.390.d: तस्य पञ्चदशस्य सत एकविँशँ होतुः प्र्ष्ठं ककुदो रूपम्
18.40.390.m: For this [rite] which is fifteen-fold, the hotṛ priest's Pṛṣṭha stotra is twenty-one-fold, representing the hump [of the bull].

18.40.390.s: indreṇa ha sma vai pūrve samājigamiṣanto vaniṣṭhusavena yajante tṛpto na indra āvirbhaviṣyati tasmai kāmān vakṣyāma iti vadantas |
18.40.390.d: इन्द्रेण ह स्म वै पूर्वे समाजिगमिषन्तो वनिष्ठुसवेन यजन्ते तृप्तो न इन्द्र आविर्भविष्यति तस्मै कामान् वक्ष्याम इति वदन्तस् ।
18.40.390.m: Wishing to meet with Indra, the ancients used to sacrifice with the Vaniṣṭhusava, saying: "Sated, Indra will appear to us; to him we shall declare our desires."

18.40.391.s: vaniṣṭhusavena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate śatam ukṣavehataḥ śataṃ dārvācitāni śatam̐ sarpiṣpātrāñ chataṃ payaḥpātrāñ chataṃ dadhipātrāñ chataṃ vasāpātrān audumbarīṃ nāvamubhayato 'bhipatanāṃ parigṛhītām atha praṇetṝn
18.40.391.d: वनिष्ठुसवेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते शतम् उक्षवेहतः शतं दार्वाचितानि शतँ सर्पिष्पात्राञ् छतं पयःपात्राञ् छतं दधिपात्राञ् छतं वसापात्रान् औदुम्बरीं नावमुभयतो ऽभिपतनां परिगृहीताम् अथ प्रणेतॄन्
18.40.391.m: When one is going to sacrifice with the Vaniṣṭhusava, he prepares one hundred barren cows, one hundred carts of firewood, one hundred vessels of clarified butter, one hundred vessels of milk, one hundred vessels of curds, one hundred vessels of fat, a boat made of udumbara wood with wings on both sides, fastened, and then the steersmen.
Having prepared this, he stops [his journey] as the Citrā [asterism] arrives.

18.40.391.s: atha citrayeti pūrvāgnim anvavasyaty uttapanīyam̐ śālīno 'nvāhāryapacanam āhitāgnis |
18.40.391.d: अथ चित्रयेति पूर्वाग्निम् अन्ववस्यत्य् उत्तपनीयँ शालीनो ऽन्वाहार्यपचनम् आहिताग्निस् ।
18.40.391.m: Then, under [the asterism of] Citrā, one who stays at home establishes the earlier fire, the heating fire; one who has established the sacred fires establishes the anvāhāryapacana fire.
Then at nightfall he puts these carts of firewood into the fire.

18.40.391.s: teṣu prajyotiṣūkṣavehato nighnanti | athaiṣām abhyardhān vaniṣṭhūn medām̐sīti śrapayanti |
18.40.391.d: तेषु प्रज्योतिषूक्षवेहतो निघ्नन्ति । अथैषाम् अभ्यर्धान् वनिष्ठून् मेदाँसीति श्रपयन्ति ।
18.40.391.m: While they blaze, they slaughter the barren cows; then they cook their entrails and fats separately.

18.40.391.s: athodita āditya āyātayaty audumbarīṃ nāvamubhayato 'bhipatanāṃ parigṛhītāṃ praṇetṛbhis
18.40.391.d: अथोदित आदित्य आयातयत्य् औदुम्बरीं नावमुभयतो ऽभिपतनां परिगृहीतां प्रणेतृभिस्
18.40.391.m: Then, when the sun has risen, he brings forward the boat made of udumbara wood, with wings on both sides, guided by the steersmen.

18.40.391.s: tasyām upastṛṇīte pañcāśatā sarpiṣpātraiḥ pañcāśatā payaḥpātraiḥ pañcāśatā dadhipātraiḥ pañcāśatā vasāpātrais
18.40.391.d: तस्याम् उपस्तृणीते पञ्चाशता सर्पिष्पात्रैः पञ्चाशता पयःपात्रैः पञ्चाशता दधिपात्रैः पञ्चाशता वसापात्रैस्
18.40.391.m: In it he spreads a layer with fifty vessels of clarified butter, fifty vessels of milk, fifty vessels of curds, [and] fifty vessels of fat.

18.40.391.s: tasyāṃ vaniṣṭhūn medām̐sīti saṃprakīryāthābhighārayati pañcāśatā vasāpātraiḥ pañcāśatā dadhipātraiḥ pañcāśatā payaḥpātraiḥ pañcāśatā sarpiṣpātrais |
18.40.391.d: तस्यां वनिष्ठून् मेदाँसीति संप्रकीर्याथाभिघारयति पञ्चाशता वसापात्रैः पञ्चाशता दधिपात्रैः पञ्चाशता पयःपात्रैः पञ्चाशता सर्पिष्पात्रैस् ।
18.40.391.m: Having scattered the entrails and fats in it, he then sprinkles over it with fifty vessels of fat, fifty vessels of curds, fifty vessels of milk, [and] fifty vessels of clarified butter.
Then he recites the invitatory verse:

18.41.392.s: indro yāto 'vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgino vajrabāhuḥ | sed u rājā kṣeti carṣaṇīnām arān na nemiḥ pari tā babhūva | iti
18.41.392.d: इन्द्रो यातो ऽवसितस्य राजा शमस्य च शृङ्गिनो वज्रबाहुः । सेद् उ राजा क्षेति चर्षणीनाम् अरान् न नेमिः परि ता बभूव । इति
18.41.392.m: "Indra is king of what moves and what rests, / of the horned beast and of what is quiet, bolt in hand; / he indeed resides as king of the peoples; / like a felly around the spokes, he has encompassed them."

18.41.392.s: yajati | indro rājā jagataś carṣaṇīnām adhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yad asti | tato dadātu dāśuṣe vasūni codad rādha upastutaś cid arvāk svāhā | iti
18.41.392.d: यजति । इन्द्रो राजा जगतश् चर्षणीनाम् अधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यद् अस्ति । ततो ददातु दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद् राध उपस्तुतश् चिद् अर्वाक् स्वाहा । इति
18.41.392.m: He offers with the offering verse: "Indra is king of the moving world, of the peoples, / whatever multiform thing is upon the earth; / therefore may he give wealth to the worshiper; / when praised, may he urge bounty hitherward. Svāhā!"
Sated indeed, Indra appears to him.

18.41.392.s: tasmai kāmān bruvate kānāndham̐ ha vādhryaśvaṃ bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso yājayāṃ cakāra
18.41.392.d: तस्मै कामान् ब्रुवते कानान्धँ ह वाध्र्यश्वं बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो याजयां चकार
18.41.392.m: They declare their desires to him. / Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa performed a sacrifice for Kānāndha Vādhryaśva.

18.41.392.s: tasya hopavasathīye 'hañ chraddhā vīyāya sa hovācādhvaryo vi vai me śraddhāgāt saṃ me yajñam̐ sthāpayeti
18.41.392.d: तस्य होपवसथीये ऽहञ् छ्रद्धा वीयाय स होवाचाध्वर्यो वि वै मे श्रद्धागात् सं मे यज्ञँ स्थापयेति
18.41.392.m: On the fast-day, his faith vanished. He said: "O adhvaryu priest, my faith has departed; bring my sacrifice to completion!"

18.41.392.s: tam̐ hovācānyad vai tad upavasathaḥ śvaste yajñaḥ sam̐sthāteti sa hovāca sam eva me sthāpayeti
18.41.392.d: तँ होवाचान्यद् वै तद् उपवसथः श्वस्ते यज्ञः सँस्थातेति स होवाच सम् एव मे स्थापयेति
18.41.392.m: He said to him: "The fast-day is one thing; tomorrow your sacrifice will conclude." He said: "Bring it to completion right now!"

18.41.392.s: tasya ha tāvad viditvāgreṇa havirdhāne carmaṇy ulūkhalamusale nidhāyām̐śūn samavakṣudāṃ cakāra yac cid dhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛhe | ulūkhalaka yujyase | iha dyumattamaṃ vada jayatām iva dundubhis | iti |
18.41.392.d: तस्य ह तावद् विदित्वाग्रेण हविर्धाने चर्मण्य् उलूखलमुसले निधायाँशून् समवक्षुदां चकार यच् चिद् धि त्वं गृहेगृहे । उलूखलक युज्यसे । इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयताम् इव दुन्दुभिस् । इति ।
18.41.392.m: Knowing that, having placed a mortar and pestle on a skin in front of the havirdhāna shed, he crushed soma shoots, [reciting:] 'For since in house after house / you, O mortar, are yoked, / speak here most splendidly, / like the drum of conquerors.'

18.41.393.s: atha hotṛcamase vasatīvarībhyo 'dhy apo niḥṣicya samudāyutya juhavāṃ cakāra yathā janā sam̐stathe vratāni kovratināṃ vratam ālobhayāti | kānāndhasya prasthitaṃ vādhryaśvasya tīvrasutam̐ śravad indra juṣasva svāhā | iti
18.41.393.d: अथ होतृचमसे वसतीवरीभ्यो ऽध्य् अपो निःषिच्य समुदायुत्य जुहवां चकार यथा जना सँस्तथे व्रतानि कोव्रतिनां व्रतम् आलोभयाति । कानान्धस्य प्रस्थितं वाध्र्यश्वस्य तीव्रसुतँ श्रवद् इन्द्र जुषस्व स्वाहा । इति
18.41.393.m: Then, pouring out water from the vasatīvarī waters into the hotṛ priest’s cup and stirring it up, he offered [it], [reciting:] 'As men have established observances, who will confound the observance of those keeping vows? / Hearing what has been set forth for Kānāndha, the fiercely pressed [soma] of Vadhryaśva, take delight, O Indra, svāhā!'

18.41.393.s: sa eṣa unmattasya vā vītaśraddhasya vā nītasya vā yajñaḥ
18.41.393.d: स एष उन्मत्तस्य वा वीतश्रद्धस्य वा नीतस्य वा यज्ञः
18.41.393.m: This is the sacrifice of one who has lost his wits, or whose faith has departed, or who has been carried away.

18.41.393.s: sā yad āgatā syād atha catuṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena yajeta purā bhreṣāc chāntyai ||
18.41.393.d: सा यद् आगता स्याद् अथ चतुष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन यजेत पुरा भ्रेषाच् छान्त्यै ॥
18.41.393.m: If it should return, he should then sacrifice with a catuṣṭoma agniṣṭoma before a mishap, for pacification.

18.42.393.s: manur vaivasvato 'kāmayata prajām̐ sṛjeya prajām avarundhīya prajāṃ vindeyā mā prajayā cakṣīrann iti
18.42.393.d: मनुर् वैवस्वतो ऽकामयत प्रजाँ सृजेय प्रजाम् अवरुन्धीय प्रजां विन्देया मा प्रजया चक्षीरन्न् इति
18.42.393.m: 'Manu Vaivasvata desired: "May I generate offspring, may I obtain offspring, may I find offspring; let them address me with offspring!"'

18.42.393.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata
18.42.393.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत
18.42.393.m: 'He saw this sacrifice; he fetched it; he sacrificed with it.'

18.42.394.s: tato vai sa prajām asṛjata prajām avārunddha prajām avindatainaṃ prajayācakṣata
18.42.394.d: ततो वै स प्रजाम् असृजत प्रजाम् अवारुन्द्ध प्रजाम् अविन्दतैनं प्रजयाचक्षत
18.42.394.m: 'Then indeed he generated offspring, he obtained offspring, he found offspring; they addressed him with offspring.'

18.42.394.s: yaḥ kāmayeta prajām̐ sṛjeya prajām avarundhīya prajāṃ vindeyā mā prajayā cakṣīrann iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.42.394.d: यः कामयेत प्रजाँ सृजेय प्रजाम् अवरुन्धीय प्रजां विन्देया मा प्रजया चक्षीरन्न् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.42.394.m: He who should desire: 'May I generate offspring, may I obtain offspring, may I find offspring; let them address me with offspring!'—he should sacrifice with this sacrifice.

18.42.394.s: prajām eva sṛjate prajām avarunddhe prajāṃ vindata ainaṃ prajayā cakṣate
18.42.394.d: प्रजाम् एव सृजते प्रजाम् अवरुन्द्धे प्रजां विन्दत ऐनं प्रजया चक्षते
18.42.394.m: He generates offspring, he obtains offspring, he finds offspring; they address him with offspring.

18.42.394.s: tasya prācīnastomās trayastrivṛtas trayaḥ pañcadaśās trayaḥ saptadaśās traya ekavim̐śāḥ
18.42.394.d: तस्य प्राचीनस्तोमास् त्रयस्त्रिवृतस् त्रयः पञ्चदशास् त्रयः सप्तदशास् त्रय एकविँशाः
18.42.394.m: Its east-facing stomas are three nine-versed, three fifteen-versed, three seventeen-versed, three twenty-one-versed.

18.42.394.s: so 'kāmayatānnādī me prajā syād annādyam avarundhītānnādyam asyāṃ pratitiṣṭhed iti
18.42.394.d: सो ऽकामयतान्नादी मे प्रजा स्याद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धीतान्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति
18.42.394.m: 'He desired: "May my offspring be eaters of food, may they obtain food, may food be established in them!"'

18.42.394.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata tato vai tasyānnādī prajābhavad annādyam avārunddhānnādyam asyāṃ pratyatiṣṭhat |
18.42.394.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत ततो वै तस्यान्नादी प्रजाभवद् अन्नाद्यम् अवारुन्द्धान्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रत्यतिष्ठत् ।
18.42.394.m: 'He saw this sacrifice; he fetched it; he sacrificed with it. / Then indeed his offspring became eaters of food, they obtained food, food was established in them.'

18.42.394.s: yaḥ kāmayetānnādī me prajā syād annādyam avarundhītānnādyam asyāṃ pratitiṣṭhed iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajetānnādy evāsya prajā bhavaty annādyam avarunddhe 'nnādyam asyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati
18.42.394.d: यः कामयेतान्नादी मे प्रजा स्याद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धीतान्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रतितिष्ठेद् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेतान्नाद्य् एवास्य प्रजा भवत्य् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्द्धे ऽन्नाद्यम् अस्यां प्रतितिष्ठति
18.42.394.m: He who should desire: 'May my offspring be eaters of food, may they obtain food, may food be established in them!'—he should sacrifice with this sacrifice. His offspring indeed becomes an eater of food, obtains food, food is established in them.

18.42.394.s: daśasudaśasu stuvate virājo ruāpam | vāg āmbhṛṇy akāmayatāparimitaṃ yaśo 'śnuvīyeti
18.42.394.d: दशसुदशसु स्तुवते विराजो रुआपम् । वाग् आम्भृण्य् अकामयतापरिमितं यशो ऽश्नुवीयेति
18.42.394.m: They praise in [groups of] ten each, the form of the Virāj. / Vāc Āmbhṛṇī desired: 'May I attain boundless fame!'

18.42.394.s: saitaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata
18.42.394.d: सैतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत
18.42.394.m: She saw this sacrifice; she fetched it; she sacrificed with it.

18.42.394.s: tato vai sāparimitaṃ yaśa āśnuta yaḥ kāmayetāparimitaṃ yaśo 'śnuvīyeti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.42.394.d: ततो वै सापरिमितं यश आश्नुत यः कामयेतापरिमितं यशो ऽश्नुवीयेति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.42.394.m: Then indeed she attained boundless fame. / He who should desire: 'May I attain boundless fame!'—he should sacrifice with this sacrifice.

18.42.395.s: tasya daśasu bahiṣpavamānaḥ śate sahasre 'yute prayute 'rbude nyarbude samudre madhye 'nte parārdhe ||
18.42.395.d: तस्य दशसु बहिष्पवमानः शते सहस्रे ऽयुते प्रयुते ऽर्बुदे न्यर्बुदे समुद्रे मध्ये ऽन्ते परार्धे ॥
18.42.395.m: Its bahiṣpavamāna chant has ten [verses], [the others] in a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million, ten million, an ocean, a middle, an end, a highest number.

18.43.395.s: yamo vaivasvato 'kāmayata pitṛṇām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ parīyām iti
18.43.395.d: यमो वैवस्वतो ऽकामयत पितृणाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं परीयाम् इति
18.43.395.m: 'Yama Vaivasvata desired: "May I attain dominion, supremacy, and sovereignty over the ancestors!"'

18.43.395.s: sa etaṃ yajñakratum apaśyat tam āharat tenāyajata tato vai sa pitṛṇām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ paryait |
18.43.395.d: स एतं यज्ञक्रतुम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनायजत ततो वै स पितृणाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं पर्यैत् ।
18.43.395.m: 'He saw this sacrifice; he fetched it; he sacrificed with it. / Then indeed he attained dominion, supremacy, and sovereignty over the ancestors.'

18.43.395.s: yaḥ kāmayeta samānānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ parīyām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.43.395.d: यः कामयेत समानानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं परीयाम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.43.395.m: He who should desire: 'May I attain dominion, supremacy, and sovereignty over my equals!'—he should sacrifice with this sacrifice.
He attains dominion, supremacy, and sovereignty over his equals.

18.43.395.s: tasya śate bahiṣpavamānaḥ sahasre 'yute niyute prayute 'rbude nyarbude samudre madhye 'nte parārdhe padve palve
18.43.395.d: तस्य शते बहिष्पवमानः सहस्रे ऽयुते नियुते प्रयुते ऽर्बुदे न्यर्बुदे समुद्रे मध्ये ऽन्ते परार्धे पद्वे पल्वे
18.43.395.m: Its bahiṣpavamāna chant has a hundred [verses], [the others] in a thousand, ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million, ten million, a hundred million, an ocean, a middle, an end, a highest number, a padva, a palva.

18.43.395.s: nityam uktvā manasaiva stuvāno manyata etāvati me stunam iti |
18.43.395.d: नित्यम् उक्त्वा मनसैव स्तुवानो मन्यत एतावति मे स्तुनम् इति ।
18.43.395.m: Having spoken the standard [chant], praising only in his mind, he thinks: 'So many verses have been praised for me.'

18.43.395.s: ātithyena pracarya gārhapatye pravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti tenāhavanīye pracarati
18.43.395.d: आतिथ्येन प्रचर्य गार्हपत्ये प्रवर्ग्यं प्रवृणक्ति तेनाहवनीये प्रचरति
18.43.395.m: Having performed the guest offering, he sets up the pravargya on the gārhapatya fire; he performs [it] with it on the āhavanīya fire.

18.43.395.s: taṃ kāla udvāsayati śiro vā etad yajñasya yad ātithyam |
18.43.395.d: तं काल उद्वासयति शिरो वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यद् आतिथ्यम् ।
18.43.395.m: He disposes of it at the proper time. The guest offering is indeed the head of the sacrifice.

18.43.395.s: yaśaḥ pravargyaḥ śīrṣann eva yajñasya yaśo dadhāti | iti nu sakṛtpravargyas |
18.43.395.d: यशः प्रवर्ग्यः शीर्षन्न् एव यज्ञस्य यशो दधाति । इति नु सकृत्प्रवर्ग्यस् ।
18.43.395.m: The pravargya is fame; he places fame right in the head of the sacrifice. / Thus indeed is the single pravargya ritual.

18.43.395.s: atha sute pravargyaḥ pavamānena caritvāgnīdhre pravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti
18.43.395.d: अथ सुते प्रवर्ग्यः पवमानेन चरित्वाग्नीध्रे प्रवर्ग्यं प्रवृणक्ति
18.43.395.m: Now, the pravargya performed when soma is pressed: having performed the pavamāna chant, he sets up the pravargya on the āgnīdhra fire.

18.43.395.s: tenāhavanīya eva pracarati taṃ tadānīm evodvāsayati
18.43.395.d: तेनाहवनीय एव प्रचरति तं तदानीम् एवोद्वासयति
18.43.395.m: With it he performs [it] on the āhavanīya fire itself; he disposes of it right then.

18.43.395.s: yaśaḥ pravargyaḥ śīrṣann eva yajñasya yaśo dadhāti |
18.43.395.d: यशः प्रवर्ग्यः शीर्षन्न् एव यज्ञस्य यशो दधाति ।
18.43.395.m: The pravargya is fame; he places fame right in the head of the sacrifice.

18.43.395.s: iti nu sutyāpravargyas | atha sakṛtpravargyas | atha sute pravargyas |
18.43.395.d: इति नु सुत्याप्रवर्ग्यस् । अथ सकृत्प्रवर्ग्यस् । अथ सुते प्रवर्ग्यस् ।
18.43.395.m: Thus indeed is the pravargya of the pressing day. / Now the single pravargya ritual; / now the pravargya when soma is pressed.

18.44.396.s: purūravā ha purā aiḍo rājā kalyāṇa āsa tam̐ horvaśyapsarābhidadhyau
18.44.396.d: पुरूरवा ह पुरा ऐडो राजा कल्याण आस तँ होर्वश्यप्सराभिदध्यौ
18.44.396.m: 'Formerly, King Purūravas, son of Iḍā, was handsome. / The apsaras Urvaśī took a fancy to him.'

18.44.396.s: tam̐ saṃvatsaraṃ kāmayamānānucacāra | evam̐ ha sma vai pūrve 'bhiśrāmyanti
18.44.396.d: तँ संवत्सरं कामयमानानुचचार । एवँ ह स्म वै पूर्वे ऽभिश्राम्यन्ति
18.44.396.m: 'Desiring him, she followed him for a year. / Thus indeed the ancients used to strive.'

18.44.396.s: tad dhāticiraṃ mene tasya ha dhāvataḥ puro rathaṃ kartaṃ darśayāmāsa
18.44.396.d: तद् धातिचिरं मेने तस्य ह धावतः पुरो रथं कर्तं दर्शयामास
18.44.396.m: 'She thought that too long. / Before him, as he was driving his chariot, she showed a chasm.'

18.44.396.s: tam̐ ha dṛṣṭvā rājāvatasthau tam̐ hāvasthāya na dadarśa |
18.44.396.d: तँ ह दृष्ट्वा राजावतस्थौ तँ हावस्थाय न ददर्श ।
18.44.396.m: 'Having seen it, the king stepped down [from the chariot]. / Having stepped down, he did not see it.'

18.44.396.s: atho ha punar ātasthau tam̐ hāsthāyaiva dadarśa
18.44.396.d: अथो ह पुनर् आतस्थौ तँ हास्थायैव ददर्श
18.44.396.m: 'Then he mounted [the chariot] again; / having mounted, he saw it indeed.'

18.44.396.s: sa ha sārathiṃ papraccha sārathe kiṃ paśyasīti tvāṃ bhagava iti hovāca ratham aśvān panthānam iti
18.44.396.d: स ह सारथिं पप्रच्छ सारथे किं पश्यसीति त्वां भगव इति होवाच रथम् अश्वान् पन्थानम् इति
18.44.396.m: 'He asked the charioteer: "Charioteer, what do you see?" / "You, lord," he said, "the chariot, the horses, the path." /'

18.44.396.s: sa hekṣāṃ cakre dṛpyāmi vai kileti
18.44.396.d: स हेक्षां चक्रे दृप्यामि वै किलेति
18.44.396.m: 'He reflected: "Surely I am losing my mind!"'

18.44.396.s: tam̐ ha vāg abhyuvāca na vai dṛpyasy ahaṃ vai tvām etaṃ kartam adīdṛśam iti | atha kas tvam iti | aham urvaśy apsareti hovāca sā tvā saṃvatsaraṃ kāmayamānānvacāriṣam |
18.44.396.d: तँ ह वाग् अभ्युवाच न वै दृप्यस्य् अहं वै त्वाम् एतं कर्तम् अदीदृशम् इति । अथ कस् त्वम् इति । अहम् उर्वश्य् अप्सरेति होवाच सा त्वा संवत्सरं कामयमानान्वचारिषम् ।
18.44.396.m: 'A voice addressed him: "You are not losing your mind! I made you see this chasm." / "Then who are you?" / "I am the apsaras Urvaśī," she said; "desiring you, I have followed you for a year.'

18.44.396.s: durupacārā ha vai bhavati devā iti hovāca kā ta upacaryeti
18.44.396.d: दुरुपचारा ह वै भवति देवा इति होवाच का त उपचर्येति
18.44.396.m: '"Divinities are hard to attend upon," he said; / "what is your condition for attendance?"'

18.44.396.s: śataṃ mamopasadaḥ syuḥ śatam̐śataṃ mā sarpiṣkumbhā aharahar āgaccheyus tadāśanā syām |
18.44.396.d: शतं ममोपसदः स्युः शतँशतं मा सर्पिष्कुम्भा अहरहर् आगच्छेयुस् तदाशना स्याम् ।
18.44.396.m: '"Let there be a hundred serving women for me; / let pots of ghee come to me by the hundreds day after day; let that be my food;'

18.44.397.s: sarvam evaitad bhagavati sukaram iti hovāca kathā tv api jāyā patiṃ nagnaṃ na paśyatīti |
18.44.397.d: सर्वम् एवैतद् भगवति सुकरम् इति होवाच कथा त्व् अपि जाया पतिं नग्नं न पश्यतीति ।
18.44.397.m: '"All this, lady, is easy to do," he said; / "but how could a wife not see her husband naked?"'
'"Wear an undergarment," she said, "do not be naked!"'

18.44.397.s: tayā sahovāsāntavāsaṃ vasānaḥ sā ha sma jātāñjātān eva putrān apavidhyati
18.44.397.d: तया सहोवासान्तवासं वसानः सा ह स्म जाताञ्जातान् एव पुत्रान् अपविध्यति
18.44.397.m: 'He lived with her, wearing an undergarment. / Whenever sons were born, she would abandon them.'

18.44.397.s: tām̐ ha rājovāca putrakāmā ha vai bhagavati vayaṃ manuṣyāḥ smo jātāñjātān u tvam apavidhyasīti
18.44.397.d: ताँ ह राजोवाच पुत्रकामा ह वै भगवति वयं मनुष्याः स्मो जाताञ्जातान् उ त्वम् अपविध्यसीति
18.44.397.m: 'The king said to her: "Lady, we humans desire sons, and yet you abandon each one as he is born!"'

18.44.397.s: sā hovāca paryavetarātrayo bhavanti kṣīṇāyuṣo 'nye bhūyaḥ priyaṃ karavāvahā iti
18.44.397.d: सा होवाच पर्यवेतरात्रयो भवन्ति क्षीणायुषो ऽन्ये भूयः प्रियं करवावहा इति
18.44.397.m: 'She said: "These are nights that have passed by, others are short-lived. / Let us make love further!"'
'She gave birth to Āyu and Amāvasu.'

18.44.397.s: sā hovācemau bibhṛtemau sarvam āyur eṣyata iti prāṅāyuḥ pravavrāja
18.44.397.d: सा होवाचेमौ बिभृतेमौ सर्वम् आयुर् एष्यत इति प्राङायुः प्रवव्राज
18.44.397.m: 'She said: "Cherish these two; these two will attain a full lifespan." / Āyu went eastward.'

18.44.397.s: tasyaite kurupañcālāḥ kāśividehā iti | etadāyavaṃ pravrājam |
18.44.397.d: तस्यैते कुरुपञ्चालाः काशिविदेहा इति । एतदायवं प्रव्राजम् ।
18.44.397.m: 'To him belong these Kuru-Pañcālas and Kāśi-Videhas. / This is the migration of Āyu.'

18.44.397.s: pratyaṅ amāvasus tasyaite gandhāraya sparśavo 'rāṭṭā iti |
18.44.397.d: प्रत्यङ् अमावसुस् तस्यैते गन्धारय स्पर्शवो ऽराट्टा इति ।
18.44.397.m: 'Amāvasu went westward. / To him belong these Gandhāris, Sparśus, and Arāṭṭas.'

18.45.397.s: atho hāsyā eṣā pūrvacittir apsarā svasā babhūva sā hekṣāṃ cakre jyog vai me svasā manuṣyeṣv avātsīd dhantainām acchāyānīti
18.45.397.d: अथो हास्या एषा पूर्वचित्तिर् अप्सरा स्वसा बभूव सा हेक्षां चक्रे ज्योग् वै मे स्वसा मनुष्येष्व् अवात्सीद् धन्तैनाम् अच्छायानीति
18.45.397.m: 'Now, the apsaras Pūrvacitti was her sister. / She reflected: "Long indeed has my sister dwelt among humans; come, let me go to her!"'

18.45.398.s: tayā sahāgatyaiva saṃgamaṃ na lebhe | atho hāsyā aviyūtham upasthāpadāsa |
18.45.398.d: तया सहागत्यैव संगमं न लेभे । अथो हास्या अवियूथम् उपस्थापदास ।
18.45.398.m: She came with her, but she did not obtain intercourse [with him]. And she had a flock of sheep stationed near her.

18.45.398.s: evam̐ ha sma vai pūrvāsāṃ mahiṣīṇām̐ rūpaṃ bhavati
18.45.398.d: एवँ ह स्म वै पूर्वासां महिषीणाँ रूपं भवति
18.45.398.m: "Such indeed used to be the form of the former chief queens."

18.45.398.s: tad vṛkarūpaṃ kṛtvā pramāthaṃ cikāya | atho hāsyā uraṇaḥ kṣīrapa āsandīpāde baddha āsa
18.45.398.d: तद् वृकरूपं कृत्वा प्रमाथं चिकाय । अथो हास्या उरणः क्षीरप आसन्दीपादे बद्ध आस
18.45.398.m: "Assuming the form of a wolf, he plotted her abduction. / And her milk-drinking ram was tied to the foot of a low chair."

18.45.398.s: tam̐ sā pramamātha tasmin hriyamāṇe ruruve 'yam avīraja iti
18.45.398.d: तँ सा प्रममाथ तस्मिन् ह्रियमाणे रुरुवे ऽयम् अवीरज इति
18.45.398.m: "She carried it off. / While it was being carried away, a cry was raised: 'Here is a weakling's son!'"

18.45.398.s: tām abhyānaśa tām abhyupeyāya tam̐ sā nakulī bhūtvā pratyupeyāya
18.45.398.d: ताम् अभ्यानश ताम् अभ्युपेयाय तँ सा नकुली भूत्वा प्रत्युपेयाय
18.45.398.m: "He reached her, he approached her. / Becoming a female mongoose, she approached him."

18.45.398.s: tasya hāntar vāsam avalulopa | atha ha sā vidyutaṃ janayāṃ cakāra
18.45.398.d: तस्य हान्तर् वासम् अवलुलोप । अथ ह सा विद्युतं जनयां चकार
18.45.398.m: "She tore away his undergarment. / Then she produced lightning."

18.45.398.s: tam̐ sā vidyuti nagnam anucakhyau | atho ha rājājagāmāsvāruhaṃ vā aham ajīta uruṇam atyasāruhaṃhi nūnamiti praty ahaṃ prajahiṣyāmīti
18.45.398.d: तँ सा विद्युति नग्नम् अनुचख्यौ । अथो ह राजाजगामास्वारुहं वा अहम् अजीत उरुणम् अत्यसारुहंहि नूनमिति प्रत्य् अहं प्रजहिष्यामीति
18.45.398.m: "In the flash of lightning, she saw him naked. / Then the king came [saying]: 'Have I not approached the horse, the unconquered ram, have I not reached it? Surely now I will cast [you] off!'"

18.45.398.s: kiṃ vyabhūd iti nagnaṃ tvādarśam iti hovāca
18.45.398.d: किं व्यभूद् इति नग्नं त्वादर्शम् इति होवाच
18.45.398.m: "‘What happened?’ [he asked]. / ‘I saw you naked,’ she said."
"When she had departed, he wandered about, pierced by displeasure and grieving."

18.45.399.s: tam̐ hovāca bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso hanta tvā śadena yājayiṣyāmyāpayi tvā punar jinviṣyāmīti
18.45.399.d: तँ होवाच बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो हन्त त्वा शदेन याजयिष्याम्यापयि त्वा पुनर् जिन्विष्यामीति
18.45.399.m: "Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa said to him: 'Come, I shall perform a Śada sacrifice for you; having caused you to obtain [her], I shall make you thrive again.'"

18.45.399.s: tam̐ śadena bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso yājayāṃ cakāra
18.45.399.d: तँ शदेन बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो याजयां चकार
18.45.399.m: "Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa performed a Śada sacrifice for him."
"Coming up from the purificatory bath, he saw her again."

18.45.399.s: tām̐ ha putrau pratītyocatur iha nau naya yatra te gatir balinau vāṃ pitaram aśuśuca iti
18.45.399.d: ताँ ह पुत्रौ प्रतीत्योचतुर् इह नौ नय यत्र ते गतिर् बलिनौ वां पितरम् अशुशुच इति
18.45.399.m: "Her two sons, meeting her, said: 'Lead us both where your course is; you two have caused your father, who is powerful, to grieve.'"

18.45.399.s: sā hovāca saṃ vāṃ putrakau janeya sāham iha tisra eva rātrīr vatsyāmi no brāhmaṇasya vaco mogham asad iti
18.45.399.d: सा होवाच सं वां पुत्रकौ जनेय साहम् इह तिस्र एव रात्रीर् वत्स्यामि नो ब्राह्मणस्य वचो मोघम् असद् इति
18.45.399.m: "She said: 'May I bring both of you, dear sons, to life! I shall dwell here for only three nights, so that the word of the brāhmaṇa may not be in vain.'"

18.45.399.s: tayā saha tisra eva rātrīr uvāsāntarvāsaṃ vasānas
18.45.399.d: तया सह तिस्र एव रात्रीर् उवासान्तर्वासं वसानस्
18.45.399.m: "He dwelt with her for only three nights, wearing an undergarment."

18.45.399.s: tasyām̐ retaḥ siṣice sā hovāca katham idam̐ syād iti
18.45.399.d: तस्याँ रेतः सिषिचे सा होवाच कथम् इदँ स्याद् इति
18.45.399.m: "His semen was poured into her. / She said: 'How could this be?'"

18.45.399.s: katham̐ hi nūnā3m iti rājā pratyuvāca
18.45.399.d: कथँ हि नूना३म् इति राजा प्रत्युवाच

18.45.399.s: sā hovāca navāṃ kumbhīm āhareti tasyām enan niḥṣiṣeca | atha ha kurukṣetre bisavatyo nāma puṣkariṇyas
18.45.399.d: सा होवाच नवां कुम्भीम् आहरेति तस्याम् एनन् निःषिषेच । अथ ह कुरुक्षेत्रे बिसवत्यो नाम पुष्करिण्यस्
18.45.399.m: "She said: 'Bring a new jar.' / She poured it into that. / Now in Kurukṣetra there are lotus pools called Bisavatīs."

18.45.400.s: tasyām enan nicakhāna tad aśvattho jajñe śamyā parivṛto retaso 'śvattha āśayācchamī |
18.45.400.d: तस्याम् एनन् निचखान तद् अश्वत्थो जज्ञे शम्या परिवृतो रेतसो ऽश्वत्थ आशयाच्छमी ।
18.45.400.m: "In it she buried it. / There an aśvattha tree was born surrounded by a śamī tree: from the seed, the aśvattha; from the receptacle, the śamī."
"This is the creation of the śamīgarbha; this is its explanation."

18.45.400.s: atha vai bhavati sarveṇa vai devāḥ suvargaṃ lokam āyan | iti
18.45.400.d: अथ वै भवति सर्वेण वै देवाः सुवर्गं लोकम् आयन् । इति
18.45.400.m: Now indeed it is said: / "By means of the whole [ritual], the gods went to the heavenly world."

18.45.400.s: sa yatra haitad yajño devebhyo 'dhi manuṣyān praty avarurohāśvattham̐ haiva tat praty avaruroha
18.45.400.d: स यत्र हैतद् यज्ञो देवेभ्यो ऽधि मनुष्यान् प्रत्य् अवरुरोहाश्वत्थँ हैव तत् प्रत्य् अवरुरोह
18.45.400.m: "When the sacrifice descended from the gods down to men, it descended upon the aśvattha tree."

18.45.400.s: tasyāraṇī cakrire 'yaṃ vāva sa yajña iti |
18.45.400.d: तस्यारणी चक्रिरे ऽयं वाव स यज्ञ इति ।
18.45.400.m: "They made the churning-sticks out of it, [saying]: 'This indeed is that sacrifice.'"

18.45.400.s: atho khalu ya eva kaścāśvatthaḥ sa śamīgarbhaḥ sa yadāhorvaśy asyāyur asi purūravā ity eteṣām evaitat pitāputrāṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇāti |
18.45.400.d: अथो खलु य एव कश्चाश्वत्थः स शमीगर्भः स यदाहोर्वश्य् अस्यायुर् असि पुरूरवा इत्य् एतेषाम् एवैतत् पितापुत्राणां नामानि गृह्णाति ।
18.45.400.m:
Now indeed, whatever kind of aśvattha tree it is, it is one growing from the inside of a śamī tree.
When he says, ‘You are Urvaśī, you are Āyu, you are Purūravas,’ he mentions the names of these very ones, father and sons.

18.45.400.s: atho sāmānyam evaitad ūheta tasyāṃ pravrajitāyāṃ puna revāpriyaviddhaḥ śocam̐ś cacāra
18.45.400.d: अथो सामान्यम् एवैतद् ऊहेत तस्यां प्रव्रजितायां पुन रेवाप्रियविद्धः शोचँश् चचार
18.45.400.m:
Now he should infer this as a general rule.
When she had departed, he wandered around again, pierced by grief, lamenting.

18.45.400.s: tam̐ hovāca bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso hanta tvaupaśadena yājayiṣyāmi vi vai te 'priyam evaiṣyatīti
18.45.400.d: तँ होवाच बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो हन्त त्वौपशदेन याजयिष्यामि वि वै ते ऽप्रियम् एवैष्यतीति
18.45.400.m: Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa said to him: ‘Come, I will sacrifice for you with the aupaśada ritual; grief will indeed leave you.’

18.45.400.s: tam aupaśadena bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso yājayāṃ cakāra tato vai tasyāpriyaṃ vinināya
18.45.400.d: तम् औपशदेन बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो याजयां चकार ततो वै तस्याप्रियं विनिनाय
18.45.400.m:
Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa sacrificed for him with the aupaśada ritual.
Then he indeed removed his grief.

18.45.400.s: tau ha vā etau paurūravasau nāma śadaupaśadau
18.45.400.d: तौ ह वा एतौ पौरूरवसौ नाम शदौपशदौ
18.45.400.m: These two are indeed named the paurūravasa śada and aupaśada [rituals].

18.45.400.s: sa yo vittam̐ siṣādhayiṣet tam̐ śadena yājayet tasya daśasu bahiṣpavamānas |
18.45.400.d: स यो वित्तँ सिषाधयिषेत् तँ शदेन याजयेत् तस्य दशसु बहिष्पवमानस् ।
18.45.400.m:
If one wishes to acquire wealth, one should sacrifice for him with the śada ritual.
His bahiṣpavamāna chant has ten [verses].

18.45.401.m: One [verse] is added successively; he presses [the soma] right here up to twenty-one [verses].

18.45.401.s: atha yo 'rpiyaṃ vininīṣet tam aupaśadena yājayet tasyaikavim̐śatyāṃ bahiṣpavamānas |
18.45.401.d: अथ यो ऽर्पियं विनिनीषेत् तम् औपशदेन याजयेत् तस्यैकविँशत्यां बहिष्पवमानस् ।
18.45.401.m:
Then, if one wishes to drive away grief, one should sacrifice for him with the aupaśada ritual.
His bahiṣpavamāna chant has twenty-one [verses].

18.45.401.s: ekaikāvaśīyata ā daśabhyas | atha prājāpatyau nāma śadaupaśadau
18.45.401.d: एकैकावशीयत आ दशभ्यस् । अथ प्राजापत्यौ नाम शदौपशदौ
18.45.401.m:
One [verse] is reduced successively down to ten.
Now the śada and aupaśada [rituals] named prājāpatya:

18.45.401.s: tasya tisṛṣu bahiṣpavamānas tisrastisra upaśīyanta ā ṣaṭtrim̐śataḥ
18.45.401.d: तस्य तिसृषु बहिष्पवमानस् तिस्रस्तिस्र उपशीयन्त आ षट्त्रिँशतः
18.45.401.m:
His bahiṣpavamāna chant has three [verses].
Three by three they are added up to thirty-six.

18.45.401.s: tisrastirso 'vaśīyanta ā tisṛbhyas | atha naidhruvasya kaśyapasya śadaupaśadau
18.45.401.d: तिस्रस्तिर्सो ऽवशीयन्त आ तिसृभ्यस् । अथ नैध्रुवस्य कश्यपस्य शदौपशदौ
18.45.401.m:
Three by three they are reduced down to three.
Now the śada and aupaśada [rituals] of Naidhruva Kaśyapa:

18.45.401.s: tasya catasṛṣu bahiṣpavamānas | catasraścatasra upaśīyanta āṣṭācatvārim̐śatas |
18.45.401.d: तस्य चतसृषु बहिष्पवमानस् । चतस्रश्चतस्र उपशीयन्त आष्टाचत्वारिँशतस् ।
18.45.401.m:
His bahiṣpavamāna chant has four [verses].
Four by four they are added up to forty-eight.
Four by four they are reduced down to four.

18.46.401.s: devāsurā ha yatra mahāsaṃgrāmam̐ saṃyetire tad dhemāni bhūtāni dvedhaiva vyapacakremur devān evānvanyāny asurān evānvanyāni
18.46.401.d: देवासुरा ह यत्र महासंग्रामँ संयेतिरे तद् धेमानि भूतानि द्वेधैव व्यपचक्रेमुर् देवान् एवान्वन्यान्य् असुरान् एवान्वन्यानि
18.46.401.m: When the gods and the asuras fought in a great battle, then these creatures divided into two sides: some followed the gods, some followed the asuras.

18.46.402.s: bṛhaspatir devānāṃ purohita āsīd uśanā kāvyo 'surāṇām |
18.46.402.d: बृहस्पतिर् देवानां पुरोहित आसीद् उशना काव्यो ऽसुराणाम् ।
18.46.402.m: Bṛhaspati was the domestic priest of the gods, Uśanas Kāvya was [the domestic priest] of the asuras.

18.46.402.s: brahmaṇvanto devā āsan brahmaṇvanto 'surās te bahūn saṃgrāmān avijayamānā āsāṃ cakrire
18.46.402.d: ब्रह्मण्वन्तो देवा आसन् ब्रह्मण्वन्तो ऽसुरास् ते बहून् संग्रामान् अविजयमाना आसां चक्रिरे
18.46.402.m:
Possessed of sacred power were the gods, possessed of sacred power were the asuras.
They remained fighting many battles without winning.

18.46.402.s: teṣāṃ na katare cana bhaviṣyad ājajñus |
18.46.402.d: तेषां न कतरे चन भविष्यद् आजज्ञुस् ।
18.46.402.m: Neither of the two knew what the future would be.

18.46.402.s: gandharvo haiva sūryavarcā bhaviṣyad ājajñe tasyo hendro jāyāyā upahāsya āsa
18.46.402.d: गन्धर्वो हैव सूर्यवर्चा भविष्यद् आजज्ञे तस्यो हेन्द्रो जायाया उपहास्य आस
18.46.402.m:
Only the gandharva Sūryavarcas knew what the future would be.
And Indra had access to his wife for amusement.

18.46.402.s: tām̐ hovācām uditāṅgi tvam idaṃ gandharvaṃ pṛccha kimartham idaṃ devāsurā na vijayantīti
18.46.402.d: ताँ होवाचाम् उदिताङ्गि त्वम् इदं गन्धर्वं पृच्छ किमर्थम् इदं देवासुरा न विजयन्तीति
18.46.402.m: He said to her: ‘O woman of radiant limbs, ask the gandharva this: "For what reason do neither the gods nor the asuras conquer?"’

18.46.402.s: taṃ tatheti hovāca tvam api śva āgacchatād iti
18.46.402.d: तं तथेति होवाच त्वम् अपि श्व आगच्छताद् इति
18.46.402.m: She said to him: ‘So be it; you too come tomorrow.’

18.46.402.s: sa hāntaḥ samudre hiraṇmayyā nāvayā sahajāni kumārayāṃ cakre |
18.46.402.d: स हान्तः समुद्रे हिरण्मय्या नावया सहजानि कुमारयां चक्रे ।
18.46.402.m: He made merry together with his wife in a golden boat in the middle of the ocean.

18.46.402.s: sa ha sauvarṇaḥ paṭaro bhūtvā naumaṇḍa upaśiśleṣa
18.46.402.d: स ह सौवर्णः पटरो भूत्वा नौमण्ड उपशिश्लेष
18.46.402.m: Having assumed the form of a golden mat, he clung to the platform of the boat.

18.46.402.s: tam̐ hāgatam eva viditvā papracchām uditāṅga tvam idaṃ brūhi kimartham idaṃ devāsurā na vijayantīti
18.46.402.d: तँ हागतम् एव विदित्वा पप्रच्छाम् उदिताङ्ग त्वम् इदं ब्रूहि किमर्थम् इदं देवासुरा न विजयन्तीति
18.46.402.m: Knowing that he had arrived, she asked: ‘O man of radiant limbs, tell me this: for what reason do neither the gods nor the asuras conquer?’

18.46.402.s: moccair iti hovāca karṇinī vai naurāpa iti
18.46.402.d: मोच्चैर् इति होवाच कर्णिनी वै नौराप इति
18.46.402.m: He said: ‘Not loudly! The boat has ears, and so does the water.’

18.46.402.s: brahmaṇvanto devā iti hovāca brahmaṇvanto 'surā iti
18.46.402.d: ब्रह्मण्वन्तो देवा इति होवाच ब्रह्मण्वन्तो ऽसुरा इति
18.46.402.m: He said: ‘The gods are possessed of sacred power, and the asuras are possessed of sacred power.’
Having heard that, Indra, having assumed the form of a green parrot, flew up.

18.46.403.s: tam̐ ha dṛṣṭvaivāha maghavan bho iti yatareṣām̐ haris te jeṣyantīti
18.46.403.d: तँ ह दृष्ट्वैवाह मघवन् भो इति यतरेषाँ हरिस् ते जेष्यन्तीति
18.46.403.m: As soon as he saw him, he said: ‘O Maghavan, those whose priest is Hari shall conquer!’

18.46.403.s: sa ha gatvaivośanasaṃ kāvyam upamantrayāṃ cakre jayantyā ca duhitrā catasṛbhiś ca kāmadughābhiḥ
18.46.403.d: स ह गत्वैवोशनसं काव्यम् उपमन्त्रयां चक्रे जयन्त्या च दुहित्रा चतसृभिश् च कामदुघाभिः
18.46.403.m: Having gone, he won over Uśanas Kāvya with his daughter Jayantī and with four wish-yielding cows.

18.46.403.d: स हाज्ञप्तो ऽसुरेभ्यो ऽधि देवान् उपसमियाय
18.46.403.m: Having been invited, he went over from the asuras to the gods.

18.46.403.s: tato ha vā etad devā asurān mahāsaṃgrāmaṃ jigyuḥ ||
18.46.403.d: ततो ह वा एतद् देवा असुरान् महासंग्रामं जिग्युः ॥
18.46.403.m: Then indeed the gods conquered the asuras in the great battle.

18.47.403.s: sa ha gurur iva mene garam iva gīrtvā bahu vittam asurāṇāṃ pratigṛhya
18.47.403.d: स ह गुरुर् इव मेने गरम् इव गीर्त्वा बहु वित्तम् असुराणां प्रतिगृह्य
18.47.403.m: Having accepted much wealth from the asuras, he felt heavy, as if he had swallowed poison.

18.47.403.s: sa hovāca gurur ivāsmi garam iva gīrtvā bahu vittam asurāṇāṃ pratigṛhya hanta mā yājayeti
18.47.403.d: स होवाच गुरुर् इवास्मि गरम् इव गीर्त्वा बहु वित्तम् असुराणां प्रतिगृह्य हन्त मा याजयेति
18.47.403.m: He said: "I am as if heavy, having swallowed as it were poison, having accepted much wealth of the Asuras. Come, sacrifice for me!"

18.47.403.s: taṃ dvādaśastomenāgniṣṭomena bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso yājayāṃ cakāra
18.47.403.d: तं द्वादशस्तोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो याजयां चकार
18.47.403.m: Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa sacrificed for him with a twelve-stoma agniṣṭoma.
Having sacrificed with that, he vomited gold upwards.

18.47.403.s: tad dha dṛṣṭvekṣāṃ cakre hantāham idam asurebhyo nirharāṇīti
18.47.403.d: तद् ध दृष्ट्वेक्षां चक्रे हन्ताहम् इदम् असुरेभ्यो निर्हराणीति
18.47.403.m: Seeing that, he considered: "Come, let me take this away for the Asuras."
Knowing that indeed, Indra turned it into stone.

18.47.403.s: te ha vā eta auśanasā nāma kurukṣetre parvatagāḥ
18.47.403.d: ते ह वा एत औशनसा नाम कुरुक्षेत्रे पर्वतगाः
18.47.403.m: These indeed are those mountain-dwelling [stones] named Auśanasa in Kurukṣetra.

18.47.404.s: sa ha laghur ivācarad apratiṣṭhitaḥ sa hovāca laghur iva vā asmy apratiṣṭhitas |
18.47.404.d: स ह लघुर् इवाचरद् अप्रतिष्ठितः स होवाच लघुर् इव वा अस्म्य् अप्रतिष्ठितस् ।
18.47.404.m: He went about as if light, unestablished. / He said: "I am indeed as if light, unestablished.

18.47.404.s: hanta mā yājayeti tam ekavim̐śatistomenāgniṣṭomena bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso yājayāṃ cakāra
18.47.404.d: हन्त मा याजयेति तम् एकविँशतिस्तोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन बृहस्पतिर् आङ्गिरसो याजयां चकार
18.47.404.m: "Come, sacrifice for me!" / Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa sacrificed for him with a twenty-one-stoma agniṣṭoma.

18.47.404.s: atho hendraḥ kāmadughā avarurudhe tam̐ ha sāyam etam uvāca prātar etād iti
18.47.404.d: अथो हेन्द्रः कामदुघा अवरुरुधे तँ ह सायम् एतम् उवाच प्रातर् एताद् इति
18.47.404.m: Then indeed Indra obstructed the wish-granting cows. / To him arriving in the evening he said: "Come in the morning!"

18.47.404.s: prātar etam uvāca sāyam etād iti
18.47.404.d: प्रातर् एतम् उवाच सायम् एताद् इति
18.47.404.m: To him arriving in the morning he said: "Come in the evening!"

18.47.404.s: sa evam eva saṃvatsaraṃ nenīyāmāsa sa hovāca prātar etād iti
18.47.404.d: स एवम् एव संवत्सरं नेनीयामास स होवाच प्रातर् एताद् इति
18.47.404.m: In this very way he kept leading [him] on for a year. / He said: "Come in the morning!"—
